cases.title: Who can take LTC, and when
Medical, court and other duty trips
Who orders, signs and is covered

cards.title: Food charges on TD: how much do I get?
cards.answer: A fixed daily amount for your pay level. No bills needed. How much you get depends on hours away.
key: Under 6 hours away: 30% of the day's amount
6 to 12 hours: 70%. Over 12 hours: 100%
Your amount: Level {level} = Rs {food_rate}/day
attach: No food bills or vouchers
watch: Hours count midnight to midnight, each day
Rates rise with DA; check the 'as of' date
cards.cite: MoD letter 12630/Mov C/242/D(Mov)/2017 dt 15-09-2017; Rule 114 TR
cards.details: Base daily amount by level before the DA-linked 25% rise: Level 14+ Rs 1,200; 12 to 13B Rs 1,000; 9 to 11 Rs 900. From 01-01-2024 (DA at 50%) it is base x 1.25 plus taxes: up to Level 11 Rs 1,125; Level 12 to 13B Rs 1,250; Level 14 and above Rs 1,500.

cards.title: Own car on TD: can I claim mileage?
cards.answer: Only with a sanction from the competent authority. Without it, you get the cost of the warrant only.
key: With a Rule 40 Note 2 sanction: road mileage allowance
Without it: cost of the warrant journey
attach: The sanction under Rule 40 Note 2
watch: Sanction must come from the GOC-in-C of the Command, or their delegate
NCC officers: only DGNCC can sanction
A Rule 47(iii) sanction covers cost of warrant only
cards.details: Audit asks one question: did travelling by own car serve a public interest, for places connected by rail?

cards.title: Home Town LTC: how often can I take it?
cards.answer: Once per calendar year, to your home town. Not in a year you take Anywhere-in-India LTC.
key: Home Town LTC (177A) or Anywhere-in-India (177B): one per year
Anywhere-in-India LTC is for alternate years only
watch: A home-town trip on a warrant counts as that year's LTC
cards.details: Field and CI postings have extra entitlements under Rule 177C; see the field-area LTC card.

cards.title: CTG on a permanent move: how much?
cards.answer: 80% of your last month's basic pay, for a permanent move of 20 km or more.
key: To or from Andaman, Nicobar or Lakshadweep: 100%
Under 20 km, or same city: one-third of the 80%
Your CTG is about Rs {ctg_estimate}
attach: Local move: vacation report, occupation report, allotment letter
watch: Basic pay only: NPA and MSP are not counted
Permanent posting only, not after study leave
cards.details: The same percentage applies to field and peace postings. If both spouses serve, separate rules apply.

cards.title: How long do I have to submit a TD or move claim?
cards.answer: 60 days from the day the journey ends. Retirement journeys get 180 days.
key: LTC claims: 30 days with an advance, 60 days without
Missed 30 days: advance recovered; you can still claim in 60
Submission date is the day you sign the contingent bill
watch: Missing both limits forfeits the claim
A late advance adjustment carries penal interest

cards.title: Home Town LTC: what do I get?
cards.answer: From your second year of service, free travel to your home town or SPR once a year. Unused LTC lapses.
key: Free conveyance by your entitled mode and class, direct route
Your family, as defined in Rule 2, can travel once too
Alternate years: any place in India instead of home town
watch: The concession lapses if you do not use it in its year

cards.title: Can my family take LTC without me?
cards.answer: Yes. Your family has its own title, even if you take no LTC that year.
key: Works even when you are on sick leave at your home town
Not for the family of an officer with under one year's service

cards.title: Parents' LTC: when can they travel?
cards.answer: Dependent parents get a yearly LTC under 177A: to your home town, or to you if they live there.
key: Yearly visit from your duty station to your home town
Parents living in your home town can visit your duty station
attach: Dependent Part II order for parents
watch: Parents visiting you in the field lapses your own LTC
Dependent orders issued after Sep 2023 are verified in the system only

cards.title: Children studying away: do they get LTC?
cards.answer: Yes. One visit a year from their college or hostel to the family, from 01-09-2008.
key: Covers children staying in hostels, under 177A or 177B
attach: Bonafide certificate from the college or institute
watch: Not extra: one LTC only in a calendar year
cards.cite: Rule 177A(viii), TR 2014; MoD letter 12647/LTC/Mov C/2970/D(Mov)/08 dt 17-12-2008

cards.title: LTC in my first year after commission?
cards.answer: No separate LTC if you used the free pre-joining warrant. If unused, claim with an IMA or OTA certificate.
key: The free home trip before you joined counts as that year's LTC
Anywhere-in-India LTC: not if you took LTC as a cadet that year
attach: IMA or OTA certificate, if the free warrant was not used

cards.title: Family still at my old station: LTC there instead of home town?
cards.answer: Yes, under 177A. But your wife's 177B entitlement lapses for that year.
key: Old duty station can replace home town under 177A
Wife's Anywhere-in-India LTC lapses for that year
attach: Non-availability certificate from your new duty station

cards.title: Sick leave on a medical board's advice: LTC?
cards.answer: You get free conveyance to the place the Medical Board recommends. It does not use up your LTC.
key: Any place in India the Medical Board recommends
Your 177A and 177B eligibility is unaffected

cards.title: Duty stopped me taking LTC: can I carry it forward?
cards.answer: Yes, if service exigencies prevented it. Use it next year; it counts as used in the original year.
key: Applies only when exigencies of service stopped you
Next year's eligibility counts it as taken in the original year

cards.title: Leave at year end: can the journey start next year?
cards.answer: Only if the leave was granted at year end and both journeys fall inside that leave.
key: Covers annual, casual, furlough, maternity and child-care leave
Onward and return journeys must both be within the leave
Next year's own LTC entitlement is not affected

cards.title: Can I change an admitted LTC claim to another rule?
cards.answer: No. Once a claim is admitted under one rule, it cannot be changed or amended.
key: Example: an admitted 177B claim cannot be switched to 177C
Choose the rule carefully before you submit

cards.title: Which rule do I write on the LTC claim?
cards.answer: Name the exact rule and sub-clause. The claim form lists each one to tick.
key: 177A Home Town; 177B anywhere in India
177C field officer visiting family at SPR; 177D study leave
Hostel children: 177A or 177B clause

cards.title: What does LTC pay for, and what not?
cards.answer: Travel only. No daily allowance, incidental expenses or local journeys.
key: Applies on annual, casual, furlough, maternity and child-care leave
Free baggage allowance only
Since 20-08-2007: no distance limit for the alternate-year trip
cards.cite: Rule 177A(i)(a) and (c), TR 2014; MoD letter B/33922/AG/PS-2(b)/3080/D(AG-II) dt 19-11-2018

cards.title: Anywhere-in-India LTC (177B): how often?
cards.answer: In alternate calendar years, for you, your wife and dependent children, to any place in India.
key: Taken in 2023 means not available in 2024
Not in the same year as Home Town LTC (177A)
Wife and children's return must finish within six months

cards.title: Family visits me at my station: effect on my LTC?
cards.answer: Only one journey is admitted. If your family visits your duty station, your own LTC for that year lapses.
key: Your trip to home town, or theirs to you: one only
Family's trip is admitted under 177A or 177B if otherwise admissible
watch: Dependent parents visiting you also lapse your own LTC

cards.title: Field or CI posting: what extra LTC do I get?
cards.answer: One extra LTC a year under 177C, to where your family lives, on top of 177A or 177B.
key: 177C: officer only, to the family at home town or SPR
177C can be taken in the same year as 177A or 177B
Family visiting your duty station: your own 177A/B lapses that year
watch: Family with you at duty station: normal 177A or 177B only
cards.cite: Rule 177A(i)(b) Note and Rule 177C, TR 2014; MoD letter 5(1)/2007/D(Mov)(I) dt 20-08-2007
cards.details: The unit commander may allow a warrant to another station where your family lives, at no extra cost to the state.

cards.title: LTC for officers posted in Andaman and Nicobar
cards.answer: You get one additional free warrant a year, including sea passage, on top of your normal LTC.
key: Additional free railway warrant with sea passage, entitled class
Between your duty station and home town or SPR
In addition to normal LTC under 177A or 177B
cards.details: Free sea passage once a year to Kolkata or Chennai is also allowed to officers posted in the islands (older MoD letter, not seen online).

cards.title: LTC to the North East, J&K or Andaman instead of home town
cards.answer: One Home Town LTC can be converted to air travel there. The scheme now runs to 25-09-2028.
key: Travel by private airlines in your entitled class, from your HQ
Not allowed if your home town and HQ are the same
Works against 177A or 177B; fare capped at the LTC-80 limit
watch: It runs in two-year periods, extended from time to time
cards.cite: Rule 177A and 177B TR; DoPT OM 31011/15/2022-Estt.A-IV dt 17-09-2024 and 09-09-2026
cards.details: One Home Town LTC in a four-year block may be converted. DoPT extended the scheme from 26-09-2024 to 25-09-2026, then to 25-09-2028.

cards.title: I used a warrant to home town in a year LTC is not due
cards.answer: The extra cost to the state is recovered from you.
key: Applies to a warrant used by mistake to your home station
Form 'D' cost for that journey is recovered the same way

cards.title: Bus fare to the rail head when my station has no rail link
cards.answer: Bus fare to and from the nearest rail head is admitted on top of your normal LTC.
key: HQ without rail: bus fare both ways to the rail head
Rail head to home town without rail: bus fare, entitled class
177B journeys between stations without rail: road mileage under Rule 179
cards.cite: Rule 177A, 177B and 179 TR; CGDA letter AT/IV/4455 dt 23-10-1986

cards.title: Breaking my LTC journey midway: what do I get?
cards.answer: On Home Town LTC you get one warrant. If you break the journey, claim the direct-journey fare.
key: Home Town LTC: no second warrant for the break
Anywhere-in-India LTC: linked warrants are allowed, same route only
Claim the cost of a direct-journey warrant under Rule 47(iii)

cards.title: Which station can my LTC warrant name?
cards.answer: Your home station as recorded in your service records. Your CO can allow a nearby station.
key: The officer issuing the warrant checks the station against your records
CO may allow another station nearest your home, at no extra cost
The authorised scale of warrants must not be exceeded

cards.title: Both of us serve: how do we claim LTC?
cards.answer: You may declare separate home towns and claim separately. No one can be claimed twice.
key: If one claims as family of the other, no self-claim
Children count in one parent's block only

cards.title: LTC where part of the route is by sea or road
cards.answer: Return sea passage is arranged on requisition. Road journeys go on warrant or cash under Rule 47.
key: Embarkation Authority arranges the sea passage on the OC unit's requisition
Road legs: warrant, or cash payment under Rule 47

cards.title: Can I start my LTC journey from another city?
cards.answer: No. Start from your duty station and go directly, by the shortest route, to your declared destination.
key: The claim is limited to the shortest direct route from duty station
A detour through another city is not paid

cards.title: LTC by air: can I break the journey or stay en route?
cards.answer: No. Book one ticket for each leg. A break in journey is not admissible, except a connecting flight.
key: One ticket per leg, even with a change of flight
An en-route stay is not allowed on air LTC
Two separate tickets: only the through-ticket fare is admitted
watch: Rail LTC differs: linked warrants are allowed for breaks (177B)

cards.title: Family lives elsewhere: LTC from where they live?
cards.answer: Yes. LTC for your wife and children runs from where they live to your leave station and back.
key: When you serve at a non-family station or have no family accommodation
Claim is limited to entitled mode and class by the shortest route
attach: Your reasons for the family living elsewhere
watch: The Controlling Authority checks those reasons
cards.cite: Rule 177B(i)(c) and (d), TR 2014; CGDA letter 4007/AT-P dt 05-05-1976

cards.title: LTC air ticket bought from an unauthorised agent
cards.answer: The air fare is not admitted. The claim passes for zero and that year's LTC counts as used.
key: Tickets must come from the three authorised agents
Only unavoidable cases can be relaxed, by a senior authority

cards.title: Family's LTC journey: warrant or fare refund?
cards.answer: You travel on warrant. Your wife and children are refunded the actual fare they paid.
key: No railway warrant for the family under 177B
Refund has no distance limit, each direction
Fare is by your entitled mode and class

cards.title: Anywhere-in-India LTC: can parents, brothers or sisters travel?
cards.answer: No. 177B covers only the officer, spouse and children.
key: Not covered: dependent parents, step-parents, brothers, sisters
Parents travel under Home Town LTC (177A) instead

cards.title: Newly married wife joining me: what travel do I get?
cards.answer: One-way LTC under 177B for her journey from your home town to the station where you serve.
key: Return to your HQ if she gives up that year's own LTC
Applies in peace, field and modified areas with married accommodation
watch: No baggage, scooter or car conveyance for her move
Marrying after your posting gives no permanent-move TA for her
cards.cite: Rule 177B(i)(a) Note and (f), and Rule 16, TR 2014

cards.title: I married while serving in a field area: wife's LTC?
cards.answer: Her LTC runs from her residence, treated like an SPR, to your leave station.
key: Limited to fare from the rail head or airport nearest you
If you take no LTC, her residence is still the base

cards.title: Wife and children's return journey: the six-month rule
cards.answer: The return must finish within six months of the onward journey, or only the onward fare is paid.
key: Return in the next calendar year needs sanction from the Competent Authority
Heads of Branches (Service HQ) or GOC-in-C (commands) may relax the limit

cards.title: Encashing leave with LTC: how much?
cards.answer: You can encash 10 days of annual leave with each LTC, up to 60 days over your career.
key: Encashed leave does not reduce what you can encash at retirement
Both spouses serving: each gets up to 60 days
No limit on the number of spells
watch: Encashment can be allowed up to 60 days before the outward journey
cards.details: The 60-day career cap applies to each spouse from 01-09-2008.

cards.title: Spouse's LTC destination must match mine
cards.answer: Your spouse travels to the same leave station as you. Going beyond it is not covered.
key: Passing through your leave station to a farther place is not admissible
Your spouse still has an independent title

cards.title: Can my family travel in batches?
cards.answer: Yes, in any number of batches. One member cannot get the concession twice in a block.
key: No limit on the number of batches

cards.title: Year-end leave: which year does my family's LTC count against?
cards.answer: If you and your family travel together next year, their LTC counts against the year yours counts.
key: Applies when your leave is granted late in the year
Next calendar year's own LTC is not affected

cards.title: LTC by bus, steamer or car: what is refunded?
cards.answer: For places connected by rail, only up to the rail warrant cost in your entitled class.
key: Private chartered buses and vans: not reimbursed
State or public-sector charter buses: actual cost, up to warrant fare
Private cars: not reimbursed, whoever owns them

cards.title: LTC when I will not return from leave
cards.answer: Not admissible if it is known at departure that you will not return to duty after the leave.
key: Applies to Anywhere-in-India LTC

cards.title: My SPR order was rejected: can I still take 177C LTC?
cards.answer: Yes, if the SPR was published but rejected. SPR relates to HRA and luggage, not to LTC.
key: SPR declaration governs HRA and luggage movement
A published but rejected SPR does not block 177C

cards.title: LTC while I am on study leave
cards.answer: Yes. Reimbursement is capped at the fare from your last duty station, or actual cost if less.
key: You: from study-leave place to anywhere in India or home town
Family staying with you: the same rule applies
Family elsewhere: from their residence, shortest route from your last duty station

cards.title: Can I take LTC on casual leave?
cards.answer: Yes. LTC is authorised on casual leave.
key: Also on annual, furlough, maternity and child-care leave

cards.title: Own car, taxi or private bus on LTC?
cards.answer: Not admissible. Private cars (owned, borrowed or hired) and private buses, vans or charters are out.
key: Government or public-sector vehicles: actual cost, up to the rail fare
Taxi, AC taxi and autorickshaw need a fare receipt
A taxi, even shared, is not allowed where state buses run
cards.cite: Rule 176(e)(i) and (ii), TR 2014; CGDA letter AT/IV/4458/XIV/6th CPC dt 04-03-2009

cards.title: Disabled officer or family member: own car or taxi on LTC?
cards.answer: Allowed, with a medical certificate and your undertaking. Paid up to the entitled rail or air fare.
key: Authorised by the Controlling Officer since 19-06-2010
Medical certificate from the competent authority
Undertaking that the authorised mode is not feasible

cards.title: Home leave fare for officers posted abroad
cards.answer: One set of home-leave fares during an overseas posting, and another at each transfer between stations abroad.
key: The officer and entitled family can travel to India and back
Available after one full year at the post abroad
The one-year limit can be relaxed by up to three months

cards.title: LTC for officers serving in Bhutan
cards.answer: Same LTC as corresponding officers in India. Road travel from Bhutan is under Rule 179.
key: Road from Bhutan to Hasimara, Bongaigaon or Rangia: Rule 179

cards.title: Road conveyance to hill stations while on leave
cards.answer: Once a year, you, your spouse and children get road conveyance to listed stations.
key: Applies on any authorised leave, including casual leave
Stations are listed by Command in the Rule 179(i) table
Road conveyance is on top of the free rail conveyance
cards.details: Examples: Nainital, Mussoorie, Shillong, Gulmarg, Mahabaleshwar, Pachmarhi.

cards.title: Air LTC for officers in remote regions
cards.answer: Special air LTC facilities exist for Ladakh, the Manipur and Mizoram region, and Tripura.
key: Ladakh, 15 Nov to 15 Mar: Leh to Srinagar, Jammu or Chandigarh
Manipur, Mizoram, Cachar, Silchar: Imphal, Aizawl or Silchar to Kolkata
Tripura: Agartala to Kolkata and back, once a year

cards.title: Form 'D': 60% rail fare on leave
cards.answer: On leave at your own expense by rail, pay 60% of your entitled class fare using Form 'D'.
key: No reservation fee; all other charges are paid in full
Six one-way forms a year for you, spouse and children
Husbands of lady officers get Form 'D' too
attach: Non-availability certificate if no form is available
watch: Not for weekends or holidays unless covered by sanctioned leave
cards.cite: Rule 181, TR 2014; MoD letter PT/2339/NHQ/passage 5870/D(Mov) dt 12-11-1975
cards.details: Two of the six forms may also cover dependent parents, sisters and minor brothers living with you. Forms issued with LTC are extra to the six.

cards.title: Army Aviation pilots: free 1,600 km rail warrant
cards.answer: Army Aviation pilots on regular flying duties get a free warrant up to 1,600 km each year.
key: 1,600 km covers the onward and return journeys together
The leave station may be over 800 km away within that total
Not in the same leave spell as 177A or 177B

cards.title: What counts as a permanent duty move?
cards.answer: A move expected to last over 180 days. A temporary move becomes permanent once it passes 180 days.
key: The ordering authority classifies it and records it in the order
Once the move has started, the classification is not revised
Courses: counted per station, not by total course length

cards.title: Peace to field posting: family's air travel?
cards.answer: Your family's air fare is paid to your SPR, yours to the new duty station, if other conditions are met.
key: Your fare: old duty station to new duty station, shortest route
Family's fare: old duty station to your SPR
Family's air entitlement mirrors yours

cards.title: No government accommodation at the new station: extra fare?
cards.answer: Yes. You get an additional fare to the old station and back, with proof of non-availability.
key: Applies when family or household stays behind for want of accommodation
attach: Non-availability certificate from the time you joined
Allotment letter when accommodation is later given
cards.cite: Rule 67(a)(i)(5), TR 2014; MoD letter 12630/TA/DA/Mov C/3003/D(Mov)/2006 dt 16-10-2006

cards.title: Two own cars: can both be moved at government cost?
cards.answer: No. Only one own car can be transported at government cost, by truck or self-propelled.
key: Officers' scale is one motor car, or one motorcycle or scooter
Actual cost is paid for carriage by rail, steamer or craft

cards.title: Leave-cum-posting journey: one claim or two?
cards.answer: Two claims: LTC for the leg to your home town, permanent-move TA for the leg to the new station.
key: Old station to home town: LTC under Rule 177A
Home town to new station: permanent move under Rule 67
cards.details: Posting via a leave station: you get TA by the direct route old to new, plus LTC for the two legs through the leave station. Family gets LTC only.

cards.title: Both spouses serving: baggage and car on transfer?
cards.answer: Moved from two places to one: 6,000 kg each. Moved from one place apart: 6,000 kg between you.
key: Each can move their own car if both need one
Posted together, moved to different stations: both get full CTG and TA
Children's TA goes to the parent they travel with

cards.title: Both spouses serving: how is CTG split?
cards.answer: Transfers within 60 days of each other: one CTG only. After that, the later spouse gets 50%.
key: Within 60 days of each other: only one CTG is paid
After 60 days but within six months: 50% to the later spouse
After six months: both get the full CTG
watch: No CTG for a transfer at your own request

cards.title: Move within the same city: what do I get?
cards.answer: No TA or CTG unless your residence changes. If it does: actual costs and one-third CTG.
key: Same station: municipality or corporation limits, with contiguous suburbs and cantonments
Conveyance and baggage: actual cost, capped as under Rule 67
CTG: one-third, once you actually change residence
cards.cite: Rule 81, TR 2014; MoD letter 12630/Mov C/242/D(Mov)/2017 dt 15-09-2017

cards.title: Posted while on leave: can I return to my old station?
cards.answer: No, unless it is ordered in the public interest. Recall only to hand over charge carries no TA.
key: Recalled only to hand over charge or collect kit: no TA
The competent leave authority may allow you to rejoin, in public interest
CTG stays admissible in these cases

cards.title: Do I send advance copies of movement orders to PCDA(O)?
cards.answer: No. Attach a copy of the movement order to each TA/DA claim instead.
key: Applies to temporary and permanent duty moves

cards.title: Leave after a course of under three months: TA?
cards.answer: Fare from the course station to the leave station is capped at one-way LTC.
key: To the leave station: actual expense, up to one-way LTC if admissible
Back to your permanent station: LTC one way, plus the course-to-station fare

cards.title: Posted while on temporary duty away from HQ: TA?
cards.answer: TD-scale TA to the new station, plus the difference between permanent and TD scales.
key: From the temporary HQ to the new duty station: TD scale
Direct journey from old to new station: the scale difference
watch: If you rejoin the old station first, attach that order

cards.title: Posted while on long leave: baggage and car moved?
cards.answer: The Controlling Officer may authorise a warrant for baggage and car left at your old station.
key: Within the authorised scale
Extra cost of a longer journey: TD-scale TA may be granted
Also covers some transfers during sick leave

cards.title: Posted while on short leave (up to four months)
cards.answer: You get the conveyance you would have got had you stayed on duty.
key: Leave up to four months, order received before or after leave starts
Lower class from your leave station: the fare you paid

cards.title: Field posting, married accommodation not allotted: baggage?
cards.answer: Baggage and car are reimbursed only with proof of government married accommodation allotted at the field station.
key: Applies to officers drawing Field or Modified Field Allowance
No proof needed if you draw CI Ops Peace allowance
Posted out later: claim with the accommodation vacation report

cards.title: Non-family field station: family travel and baggage?
cards.answer: Not admissible at government cost, even if you arrange your own accommodation.
key: Applies to field areas where families are not permitted

cards.title: Single officer, peace to field: baggage allowed?
cards.answer: Up to 5,900 kg to your home town, plus 100 kg on warrant: 6,000 kg in all.
key: 100 kg goes with you on warrant
The rest goes to your home town or SPR
Total must stay within your maximum entitlement
cards.cite: MoD letter 12630/TA/DA/Mov C/13/D(Mov)/18 dt 18-04-2018; Rule 67(d)(vii) TR

cards.title: Baggage by rail or road: how much and what rate?
cards.answer: Level 10 and above: up to 6,000 kg by goods train or container, or road at a per-km rate.
key: Level 12 and above: double container; Levels 10 to 11: single container
Road base rate Rs 50 per km, plus the DA-linked 25% rise
watch: Receipts and vouchers are needed for the claim
cards.cite: MoD letter 12630/Mov C/242/D(Mov)/2017 dt 15-09-2017; Rule 61A, TR 2014
cards.details: Rates follow the HRA city class (X, Y, Z). Higher X and Y rates apply to moves between X or Y and Z cities. Rule 61A Note 3 also raises rates 25% whenever DA rises 50%.

cards.title: How do I travel on a permanent posting?
cards.answer: Your travel entitlement is the same as for temporary duty, mode by mode.
key: Rail: on warrant, unless the competent authority allows cash payment
Cash payment: fare of the class travelled or entitled, whichever is less
Own accord without warrant: cost of warrant or actual, whichever is less

cards.title: Newly commissioned: travel to my first station
cards.answer: AC II on warrant from home or your academy, family by direct route, and 225 kg baggage on warrant.
key: Family: free conveyance from your home to the permanent station
Baggage up to 225 kg, including 55 kg from the training unit
Daily allowance for the journey period; no CTG
cards.cite: Rule 64 and Rule 65, TR 2014; CGDA letter 4199/AT-P dt 09-04-1973

cards.title: Re-employed after retirement: travel to my first station
cards.answer: AC II on warrant for you and your family, from your home to the reporting station.
key: Re-employed within six months: unclaimed retirement TA can be claimed later
Lower class if there is no AC II on the line
cards.cite: Rule 64, Rule 201 and Rule 206, TR 2014; SAI 1/S/80

cards.title: Baggage carried on free government transport
cards.answer: What the free transport carries is deducted from your entitlement. Any excess is recovered.
key: Applies when free road transport is provided on transfer
Recovery is at the rate you would have been reimbursed

cards.title: Married while in a field area: wife's move to a peace station
cards.answer: Her conveyance is paid under Rule 85, limited to the lower of two costs.
key: Rail head nearest your old field station to the new peace station
Or her residence to the new peace station, if less
Baggage conveyance is allowed from her place of residence

cards.title: My family moves before or after me: what is paid?
cards.answer: Warrant, or the lower of the entitled-class fare and the actual fare. Officers' families may fly.
key: Baggage up to your maximum scale, less what you carry yourself
Government liability stops at the old-to-new station distance

cards.title: Family joining me in government married accommodation in a field area
cards.answer: One-time free warrant for your family and baggage from their residence, once accommodation is allotted.
key: Only government-built married accommodation, not hired or requisitioned
Baggage limited to what was first moved to the SPR
Valid only while the station is a family station

cards.title: Officer lent to another department: whose travel rules apply?
cards.answer: Those of the lending or borrowing department, depending on whose pay scale you draw.
key: The borrowing department bears the cost
Unless the loan letter says otherwise

cards.title: MNS officer: my husband's travel entitlements
cards.answer: He is part of your family and gets its facilities, unless his own employer gives the same.
key: No proof of dependency and no income limit
You must give details of his job

cards.title: Can a Lieutenant travel by air on TD?
cards.answer: Yes. All commissioned officers, including MNS officers, are entitled to travel by air.
key: Levels 5A to 11 and Levels 12 to 13B: economy class
Level 14 and above: business or club class
cards.cite: MoD letter 12630/Mov C/242/D(Mov)/2017 dt 15-09-2017; Rule 62 TR

cards.title: MNS officers: TA/DA, LTC and concession vouchers
cards.answer: Same TA/DA as other service officers. LTC is the same, but with Form G at 50% fare.
key: Form G: 50% of the fare, including reservation charges
Six one-way journeys a year, like Form D
Form D is not available to MNS officers
cards.cite: Rule 178 and Rule 182, TR 2014; MoD letter B/83878/DGAFMS/MNS/2204/D(Mov) dt 01-06-1981
cards.details: Family members of MNS officers may use Form 'D', but Form 'D' and Form G together are capped at six a calendar year.

cards.title: Missed connection, night in a transit city: reimbursed?
cards.answer: Yes. Hotel rent, conveyance and food are payable for an enforced halt.
key: Applies on temporary duty when no connecting flight is available that day

cards.title: Attached for investigation of a disciplinary case: DA for the halt?
cards.answer: No. DA is not paid for halts when you are attached only for investigation or progress of a case.
key: If detailed for specific duty during it, DA is paid
Such an attachment stays temporary, even beyond 180 days

cards.title: TA/DA to attend my Corps Raising Day?
cards.answer: Not admissible. TA/DA is not paid for a TD to attend functions such as Raising Day.
key: Such functions are not treated as duty for TA/DA

cards.title: DA on a long TD: how long is it paid?
cards.answer: Full DA for the first 180 days of continuous halt at one place. After that, none.
key: Beyond 180 days the right course is to issue transfer orders

cards.title: DA on holidays and casual leave during TD
cards.answer: DA is paid on holidays during TD. It is not paid on restricted holidays or casual leave.
key: Half-day casual leave: half DA
DA covers only the minimum time you needed to be away
watch: Leaving early or returning late for a holiday can be deducted

cards.title: TD within my own city: when is TA and DA paid?
cards.answer: TA is paid if the duty place is over 8 km from your normal place. DA is at half rate.
key: Measured from your normal place of duty, even from home
No DA on a day you stay within 8 km

cards.title: Officers attached to HQs under Para 93 DSR: DA?
cards.answer: Full DA for the first 20 days, then half rate up to 42 days.
key: Attachment is for up to six months at a time, without replacement
After 42 days: half rate, if the authority allows
No DA beyond 90 days in all

cards.title: Sent to help the civil authorities at another station: TA/DA?
cards.answer: Normal TA/DA under Rules 114 and 119. State hospitality changes the DA under Rule 114(iv).
key: Applies when detailed with or without a detachment
Republic Day Parade detachments get the same normal TA/DA
cards.cite: Rule 114 and Rule 119, TR 2014; MoD UO B/68529/Q/RRC/1373 D(Mov) dt 30-11-1977

cards.title: DA on Rajdhani Express journeys
cards.answer: Full DA for the journey period, even though the fare includes meals.
key: The meal charge in the fare does not reduce your DA
cards.cite: Rule 95 TR; MoD letter B/89621/PC-16/Q Mov C/3497/D(Mov) dt 17-08-1978

cards.title: Travel to receive a Sena or Vishisht Seva Medal
cards.answer: Serving recipients are treated as on temporary duty. Ex-servicemen and next of kin get TA or a warrant.
key: Serving: from your unit to the place of presentation and back
Ex-servicemen and next of kin of posthumous awardees: from home
One guest per recipient gets a single fare each way
cards.details: Class is what the winner was entitled to in service, or lower if actually used. Road mileage is paid where there is no rail. Ex-servicemen officers get DA for up to three days at the investiture; next of kin of posthumous awardees get free board and lodging for three days. The 1987 letter allowed incidentals of Rs 37 a day for up to 4 days instead of DA (historic figure). The unit or nearest formation pays the advance.

cards.title: Train and air class by pay level
cards.answer: Level 14 and above: business class or AC I. Levels 12 to 13B: economy or AC I. Levels 5A to 11: economy or AC II.
key: Premium, Premium Tatkal and Suvidha trains are allowed
Dynamic or flexi fare in Shatabdi, Rajdhani and Duranto is reimbursed
Shatabdi-type trains: Levels 5A to 11 chair car; 12 and above executive
cards.cite: Rule 92 and Rule 108, TR 2014; MoD letter 12630/Mov C/242/D(Mov)/2017 dt 15-09-2017

cards.title: Road journeys on TD and LTC: what is allowed?
cards.answer: No rail link: AC bus if you are entitled to AC II or above. Rail-linked places: any public transport.
key: Rail-linked places: total fare must not exceed the entitled train fare
You may always travel below your entitled class
LTC travel has the same entitlement but no daily allowance

cards.title: General Officer: LTC by air where there are no direct flights
cards.answer: A General Officer can fly to the airport nearest the destination, by the shortest direct route.
key: Applies to your home town or any declared destination
Rajdhani or Shatabdi fare only if you actually travelled by them
Taxi or auto only where there is no rail link
cards.cite: MoD letter 12630/TA/DA/7thCPC/Mov C/85/D(Mov)/2018 dt 14-05-2018; DoPT OM 31011/8/2017-Estt.A-IV dt 19-09-2017
cards.details: A higher class or another mode cannot be claimed on a notional basis against the Rajdhani fare. Taxi or auto must run regular licensed routes. Local taxi from home to the station is not reimbursable. If several State bus services run, the lowest fare is paid.

cards.title: Which pay counts for my TA/DA level?
cards.answer: Your basic pay in the pay level. NPA, MSP and special pay are not counted.
key: Basic pay as defined in the Army pay-rules SROs
Applies from 01-07-2017

cards.title: TD to Bhutan: what DA is paid?
cards.answer: The DA fixed for that country. Only 25% if the host gives lodging and all meals.
key: Full entitled DA at the rate the Government sets for that country
State guest with lodging and meals provided: 25%
Free tent or improvised lodging does not cut DA
cards.cite: Rule 268 and Rule 114(iv), TR 2014; ADGSM/Mov C letter 15449/TA/DA/Mov C dt 18-03-2016; CGDA letter AT/IV/4388/X dt 16-03-2017
cards.details: Applies equally to the joint training cycle with the Royal Bhutan Army. The move sanction must state the nature of duty and the status of boarding and lodging, including any improvised accommodation.

cards.title: Family visiting me on a long course
cards.answer: Only if the course lasts more than 90 days.
key: Family starts from your duty station or your SPR
A course of exactly 90 days or less does not qualify

cards.title: Attending a course: TA and DA
cards.answer: TA under Rule 124; DA under Rule 123. Full DA for up to 180 days if no free board and lodging.
key: Free board and lodging provided: DA is reduced
Course at two stations: 180 days of full DA at each
Language Aptitude Tests in New Delhi: normal TD TA and DA

cards.title: Course at my own HQ station: TA and DA
cards.answer: At your HQ station: no DA or mileage. In nearby areas beyond 8 km: mileage and 50% DA.
key: Elsewhere: one onward and return mileage plus normal DA
A centre at your HQ is treated as your temporary HQ
No DA for a same-station visit made from home
cards.cite: Rule 129 and Note 5 under Rule 114(vi), TR 2014

cards.title: Command Preparatory Staff College course: TA and DA
cards.answer: TA and DA are admissible to student officers and instructors at another station.
key: Applies at a station other than your permanent station

cards.title: Obligatory departmental exam: what is paid?
cards.answer: Only conveyance (TA). No food charges, hotel or DA for halts.
key: Applies to exams for retention or promotion
Not for exams covered by Rules 124 and 125

cards.title: DA for a professional-subject exam
cards.answer: DA is payable for halts, whether you are examinee, examiner or board member.
key: Not if you are on leave at the exam station
Not for a re-attempt after failing, unless ordered outside your command
Voluntary language exams: only boards and examiners get DA

cards.title: Course or exam while I am on leave: conveyance?
cards.answer: Annual leave alone: what you would have got on duty. Other leave: from your residence and back.
key: Other leave: the cost must not exceed what duty would have cost
No conveyance if you do not go for your own convenience

cards.title: Single officer, peace to peace: baggage allowed?
cards.answer: Up to 6,000 kg of baggage and your vehicle, moved between your two stations.
key: Applies to a permanent posting between peace stations
cards.cite: Rule 61A, TR 2014; MoD letter 12630/Mov C/242/D(Mov)/2017 dt 15-09-2017

cards.title: Road mileage on TD: which legs are paid?
cards.answer: Without government transport, one road mileage each way between HQ, the railway station and the duty point.
key: Rate is the RTO-fixed taxi or rickshaw rate there
Government pool transport may be provided where essential

cards.title: Using a service aircraft while on leave
cards.answer: Not allowed without specific Government orders. Otherwise the civil airfare is recovered from you.
key: Exceptions are certain air courier services under specific orders

cards.title: GST on a hotel stay on TD: reimbursed?
cards.answer: Yes. The hotel ceiling excludes GST, and GST is reimbursed on top.
key: Applies to hotel or guest-house stays on tour
GST is worked out on the actual charges paid
cards.details: The first clarification that GST is outside the ceiling was dated 10-10-2017.

cards.title: Move sanction, movement order or detention certificate: which proves the TD period?
cards.answer: The move sanction. It must show the TD period; the others cannot replace it.
key: Detention certificate shows how long you were detained at the TD station
Movement order shows only the date you moved from the unit
watch: A similar claim passed for someone else is no precedent

cards.title: Certificates to include in a TD claim
cards.answer: State your stay, and how you travelled by road.
key: Stay: hotel or guest room, free messing, free transport; yes or no
Road: own car, shared taxi, or full taxi or auto
If you claim mileage: that no government transport was used

cards.title: Car conveyance rate between X, Y and Z cities
cards.answer: Paid at the road mileage rate of the city you start from, whatever the city class.
key: Not based on the weight of the car

cards.title: A free last leg of my LTC journey: how to claim?
cards.answer: Show the whole journey up to your home town in the claim, even if that last leg is not paid.
key: Leaving it out can lead to rejection for not visiting the place
Resubmit the claim with the clarification

cards.title: Attending a conference on my own request
cards.answer: If government interest is served, you get conveyance of your entitled class each way.
key: Officially sent to a conference: TA and DA as for temporary duty
Moves not covered by the regulations are sanctioned under Rule 4(ii)

cards.title: Regimental conferences: who gets TA and DA?
cards.answer: TD-scale TA and DA for one officer per infantry battalion, every two years.
key: To the regimental centre of the battalion's group
Commanding Officers of Gorkha units: the annual conference at Kunraghat

cards.title: Sports meetings and championships: TA and DA
cards.answer: Normal TD TA and DA for Board meetings. Army officers in Services Championships get a warrant only.
key: National championships, tournaments, coaching camps: TD scale
Preliminary and final rounds of Services Championships: warrant, no DA
Claims must be countersigned by the officer who convened the meeting

cards.title: Travel to training camps and exercises
cards.answer: Participants travel on a railway warrant. Travel another way and you get the cost of the warrant.
key: Staff exercise at IHQ of MoD (Army): TD-scale TA and DA
Artillery practice camps: TD scale, except with units or as spectators
HQ officers on manoeuvres, inspecting or as spectators: TD scale

cards.title: Referred to another station for treatment: what is paid?
cards.answer: TA at TD scale for the journey only. No DA and no food charges.
key: Also for dental treatment under the medical rules
Also when moved to a service hospital where your station has none

cards.title: TD while on leave, or leave before and after TD
cards.answer: Annual leave added to a TD gives one-way fare only. Casual leave does not change your fare.
key: TD detailed on leave: TA from your leave place and back
Casual leave combined with TD: no DA for those days
attach: Prior permission of the Controlling Officer

cards.title: Officiating in a leave vacancy: TA and DA?
cards.answer: TD-scale TA and DA with sanction, if the absent officer's duties cannot be left unattended.
key: AMC officers: DGAFMS sanctions; NCC officers: DGNCC
AMC officers covering casual leave over 5 days: normal TA and DA

cards.title: Recalled from leave: what is paid?
cards.answer: TA at TD scale for the return from where the order reaches you. Not for casual leave.
key: The leave authority certifies the emergency could not be foreseen
Leave must be cut short by more than half
Returning later to finish leave: TA at the same scale

cards.title: Colonel of the Regiment: visits to units
cards.answer: TD-scale conveyance by air, rail, road and sea for yearly unit visits.
key: Armoured regiment: one visit a year
Infantry regiment up to 12 battalions: six visits a year
More than 12 battalions: visits equal to 50% of the battalions

cards.title: Collecting tickets, visas or passports for an official journey
cards.answer: Conveyance by public transport is admissible, for you or the person you depute.
key: Within India and abroad
Controlling Officer controls the facility

cards.title: NCC camps: DA for regular officers posted to NCC
cards.answer: DA at one-quarter of the Rule 114-A rate.
key: Applies to regular officers attending NCC camps

cards.title: Liaison or security duty with foreign dignitaries: TA and DA
cards.answer: Normal TA to join the delegation and return to your duty station.
key: Travel class: your normal entitlement as far as possible
A higher class only where absolutely necessary
No DA in transit; food and incidentals paid by Government
cards.details: A higher rail class needs prior MoD sanction. Road and air travel with the dignitary is allowed where necessary.

cards.title: Witness in a court: conveyance?
cards.answer: Free conveyance if the facts you testify to came from your public duties.
key: Civil court in a criminal case involving state interests: free conveyance
Do not accept TA from the court when conveyance is provided
Summoned while on leave: conveyance as if on duty

cards.title: Relatives visiting a dangerously ill officer, or a funeral
cards.answer: Free conveyance for two relatives to visit, or three persons for a funeral.
key: Same class as the patient or the deceased, by rail or road
Battle casualty in hospital over three months: two relatives every six months
watch: Not if the illness or death is due to your own misconduct

cards.title: What do 177A, 177B, 177C and 177D mean?
cards.answer: 177A is Home Town LTC. 177B is anywhere in India. 177C is for field officers. 177D is study leave.
key: 177A: you, family and dependent parents, every year
177B: you, spouse and children, in alternate years
Family visits you in the field under 177B: your own 177B lapses

cards.title: Who counts as my family for TA and LTC?
cards.answer: Your spouse, two surviving unmarried children, and wholly dependent relatives as Rule 2 defines.
key: Parents and step-parents: living with you and wholly dependent
Minor brothers, unmarried, widowed or separated sisters, living with you
watch: LTC covers only two surviving children, with some exceptions
For LTC, dependent parents qualify even if they live elsewhere
cards.cite: Rule 2(p), TR 2014; MoD letter 12647/Q Mov C/2610/D(Mov)/98 dt 11-09-1998

cards.title: Attending a court of inquiry or court martial as the accused
cards.answer: It counts as duty. TA and DA are paid if the move is sanctioned and not held at your request.
key: Not treated as a transfer for misconduct
Sanction must come from the Competent Authority in Appendix III

cards.title: When is TA admissible?
cards.answer: Only for bonafide official duty, not for personal convenience or misconduct.
key: A transfer at your own request can count as public interest
For misconduct, a commander may still permit travel on duty

cards.title: Staying in a hotel on TD: the non-availability certificate
cards.answer: Hotel bills are admitted only with the prescribed detention certificate saying no guest room was available.
key: Hotel is allowed only when all available guest rooms are occupied
Certificate carries the case file number, station and date
The issuer checks that all guest rooms were full
cards.cite: IHQ (Army) ADG PS, AG's Branch, SAPCS Advisory 03/2022; MoD letter 12630/TA/Mov C/198/D(Mov)/2018 dt 06-12-2018
cards.details: Local journeys over 8 km between TD points more than 50 km apart in one city are made as civilians do; a taxi or scooter needs prior permission. Free board and lodging no longer gives 25% DA, but food bills still fall by the ration cost under Rule 114(xii).

cards.title: Who sanctions my TD move?
cards.answer: The authority listed in Appendix III, only for moves the regulations or a Government letter allow.
key: Other moves need specific sanction under Rule 4(ii)
No authority can sanction their own move; the next higher one does
NPF audit: certificate that officers are not available locally
cards.cite: Rule 4(ii) TR; AO 237/1970; CGDA letter AT/IV/4416/Vol.II dt 10-07-1984

cards.title: Delegating a Controlling Officer's powers
cards.answer: The Controlling Officer needs the Competent Authority's express permission, and the delegation must say whose powers they are.
key: Powers may be the local superior's or the Controlling Officer's
Only the Controlling Officer's powers need that permission

cards.title: Documents to attach to a TD claim
cards.answer: The original move sanction, the duty performed, the warrant number and date, and the actual fare paid.
key: Move sanction in original, under Appendix III or Rule 4(ii)
The specific duty you performed at the outstation
Actual mode and fare from duty point to station, with a certificate

cards.title: Sharing a hotel room: how is it reimbursed?
cards.answer: Proportionately, by the number of officers or family members who share.
key: The amount paid is divided among those sharing the room

cards.title: Where do I send TA/DA claims for a posting or TD abroad?
cards.answer: To PCDA(O) Pune.
key: Applies to posting, TD or deputation abroad

cards.title: Who countersigns my TA claim?
cards.answer: If a Competent Authority sanctioned the move, your local superior. Otherwise your Controlling Officer.
key: Major General and above can claim without countersignature
Officers in Appendix IV can too
watch: They still cannot sanction their own move
If you are your own Controlling Officer, your immediate superior countersigns

cards.title: State hospitality on TD: certificate to attach
cards.answer: Attach a certificate from the CO of the TD station showing any free messing and accommodation you had.
key: It lets the Controlling Authority check your claim

cards.title: Why are TA claims returned?
cards.answer: Incomplete claims are returned. Give full particulars, original sanctions signed in ink, and vouchers.
key: Countersigning authority makes the Rule 9 checks
Returned claims mean delay and avoidable correspondence

cards.title: Preparing a claim: form, ink and advance adjustment
cards.answer: Claims must be legible, in ink or typed, on the prescribed form. Adjust an advance on time.
key: Advance drawn: adjust within 60 days (TD, move) or 30 days (LTC)
Prefer the adjustment immediately after the return journey
watch: Late adjustment is recovered with penal interest
cards.cite: Rule 17A TR; MoD letter 12630/TA/Mov C/198/D(Mov)/2018 dt 06-12-2018

cards.title: Promoted with retrospective effect: is my TA revised?
cards.answer: Not for the period before the notification, unless your duties changed.
key: Claims not yet audited follow the retrospective notification
Claims already audited are not revised

cards.title: Family follows me on a permanent move: time limit
cards.answer: Within six months of your move. Special cases up to one year, with sanction.
key: Waiting for accommodation: six months run from when it is available
Car: six months from your own move
Within the limit, family and baggage count as accompanying you

cards.title: Retirement: lien on conveyance
cards.answer: Use your retirement conveyance within one year. Family may go ahead by two months, or follow within a year.
key: Two months from your retirement; the year from your own move
DGOL & SM can extend the year

cards.title: Family sent ahead, then my posting is cancelled
cards.answer: Family and baggage sent early travel at your own risk. A refund of baggage cost is possible.
key: Baggage refund at goods-train rate, if not sent unduly early
No compensation for the family's journey if the posting changes
The family's claim is admitted finally only when you actually move

cards.title: Baggage and car moved in stages (A to B to C)
cards.answer: The six-month limit also covers baggage and car, with weight and cost capped across the stages.
key: Total weight must not exceed the maximum scale
Total cost must not exceed A-to-B plus B-to-C

cards.title: Lien beyond one year: who sanctions?
cards.answer: DGOL & SM for family and baggage. DGOL for private conveyance.
key: Applies to permanent transfer, beyond one year from your move

cards.title: My TD or LTC was cancelled but I drew an advance
cards.answer: Pay it back at once, to PCDA(O) Pune only, by MRO. It is not recovered automatically.
key: Delay means recovery with penal interest
cards.details: Check the current PCDA(O) MRO code on the PCDA(O) Pune website before paying.

cards.title: Penal interest on a TA advance: when and how much?
cards.answer: Charged at the GPF rate plus 2%, from the day of drawal to refund.
key: Timely claim: interest on the unused part only
Late claim: whole advance recovered, with interest on all
Correctly charged interest is not refunded
cards.cite: Rule 17A, TR 2014; MoD (DMA) letter 12692/PI/Mov C/42/D(Mov)/2022 dt 18-01-2022
cards.details: The handbook gave 7.1% + 2% = 9.1% a year at the time; the base moves with the GPF rate.

cards.title: Advance for the family of an officer who dies in service
cards.answer: The Commanding Officer of the unit can draw it, under Rule 216.
key: Subject to the conditions in Rule 21

cards.title: Advance for a course of instruction
cards.answer: TA plus DA for the course is paid ten days before you leave.
key: Return TA is paid ten days before the course ends
Since 01-01-2015: draw it all online at once (CAT A and B)
Adjustment claim goes to your own unit, countersigned by the CO

cards.title: Drawing more advance than my entitlement
cards.answer: Not allowed. The excess and its penal interest are recovered in one sum.
key: Recovery from your IRLA, or by treasury deposit
Over-drawing is treated as highly irregular
cards.cite: Rule 17(vi), TR 2014; CGDA letter AT/IV/4378 dt 12-02-1982

cards.title: Advance for officers on deputation to Assam Rifles
cards.answer: You can draw TA, DA or LTC advance from PCDA(O) under Rule 17.
key: The advance must be one the rules authorise
cards.cite: Rule 17 TR; MoD letters 1137/D(Pay/Services) dt 15-02-1963 and 84048/AG/PS3(d)/323-S/D(Pay-Services) dt 21-04-1980

cards.title: LTC advance: how early, and what conditions?
cards.answer: For rail journeys, draw it up to 125 days before the move. Show the outward tickets within 10 days.
key: Move cancelled: refund the advance at once, in one sum
Outward journey not started within 120 days: refund forthwith
cards.cite: Rule 17(i)(B)(i), TR 2014; MoD letter 12647/LTC/Mov C/62/D(Mov)/2016 dt 19-07-2016; DoPT OM 31011/8/2015-Estt(A.IV) dt 13-05-2016
cards.details: TR 2014 originally said 95 days. The 2016 MoD letter raised it to 125 days from 01-04-2015, to suit rail booking. DoPT keeps 65 days for other modes of travel.

cards.title: Adjusting an advance: when, and what if I do not
cards.answer: Submit the adjustment TA bill right after the journey, complete in all respects.
key: Otherwise PCDA(O) may recover the advance with penal interest
Recovered from your pay in the second month after the journey

cards.title: A second advance while one is outstanding
cards.answer: Not ordinarily allowed. Check that no earlier advance is outstanding.
key: Concurrent advances should be avoided

cards.title: Who can draw a TA advance, and for what?
cards.answer: For TD, permanent move and LTC, up to your actual entitlement, if the amount exceeds Rs 50.
key: No advance for journeys on retirement
cards.cite: Rule 17(i)(A), TR 2014; AHQ letter 12059/Q Mov C dt 01-07-1992

cards.title: Warrant, requisition, credit note, cash: how is conveyance given?
cards.answer: Directly by warrant, requisition, credit note or cash, or indirectly as passage or TA.
key: Other mode or class: the lower of actual fare and Government's cost
Warrant not used: the warrant's value, with the Controlling Officer's sanction

cards.title: Routes: main route and longer routes
cards.answer: On warrant or requisition, take the main route. Another route needs a medical or military reason.
key: LTC warrants under 177A, 177B, 177C and Rule 180: main route
Andaman and Nicobar: NOIC or Embarkation Commandants can sanction a longer route
watch: Commandants must ensure you will not be held at port

cards.title: Cancelling an official ticket: are charges refunded?
cards.answer: Yes, when the journey is cancelled in public interest or for reasons beyond your control. Not on LTC.
key: Tatkal cancellation charges are reimbursable too
Attach a certificate under Rule 44
Your family's charges are refunded in the same way

cards.title: Railway supplementary and reservation charges
cards.answer: Reimbursed as part of the fare, for officers and families.
key: Superfast and express supplementary charges, and reservation charges
Claim them through your TA claim
Link a supplementary claim to the original claim

cards.title: Ferry charges and tolls on duty
cards.answer: Within 8 km of your station, you can claim actual ferry, toll and rail fares.
key: Tolls on a warrant road journey are reimbursed

cards.title: I travelled by rail without using my warrant
cards.answer: You get the warrant's cost at public tariff, or the actual expenditure if less.
key: Needs the Controlling Officer's sanction under Rule 47(iii)
Applies to you and your family

cards.title: Sea or river steamer class by pay level
cards.answer: Level 10 and above: the highest class. To the islands by SCI ships: deluxe class.
key: Mainland to Andaman, Nicobar or Lakshadweep by Shipping Corporation ships: deluxe
cards.cite: Rule 58 and Rule 107, TR 2014; MoD letter 12630/Mov C/242/D(Mov)/2017 dt 15-09-2017

cards.title: Road mileage allowance by pay level
cards.answer: Level 14 and above: actual public bus fare, AC taxi or auto rates. Levels 10 to 13B: no AC taxi.
key: Actual fare by any public bus, including AC bus
Taxi or auto journeys: at the prescribed rates
Own car, scooter or motorcycle: paid at the auto-rickshaw rate
cards.details: Where State or neighbouring States have no rates: base Rs 24 a km for own car or taxi and Rs 12 a km for auto-rickshaw or own scooter, from 01-07-2017. The rates rise 25% each time DA rises by 50%; DA passed 50% on 01-01-2024.

cards.title: Free baggage on a warrant journey
cards.answer: Railways allow 40 kg of baggage, including bedding, free on a warrant journey.
key: The cost of heavier baggage is not covered by the free allowance

cards.title: Who issues warrants, requisitions and credit notes?
cards.answer: Only the authorised persons in Appendix X, who are liable for loss through misuse.
key: A warrant states the actual route, class and baggage weight
Use reduced return tickets where they are available
Payments not by warrant are made by credit note

cards.title: TA on retirement: what do I get?
cards.answer: Conveyance, baggage, car and CTG from your last station to your home or chosen place, as on a permanent move.
key: You and family travel on cash TA; no warrant
CTG at the same rate as on a permanent move
Premature retirement gets the same benefits
cards.cite: Rule 200A(a), TR 2014; CGDA letter AT/IV/039 dt 04-08-1980

cards.title: Settling at my last duty station after retirement
cards.answer: If your residence changes, you get TA for the move, and one-third CTG.
key: Self: actual cost, up to road mileage under Rule 61
Family: one mileage for two members, one more for more than two
Settling within 20 km: one-third CTG if you actually change residence

cards.title: Outgoing Service Chiefs: free airlift on retirement
cards.answer: One free Air Force airlift for the Chief, family and baggage, from Delhi to the airport nearest home.
key: Then by surface route to the home town or SPR
Baggage is reduced by what the aircraft carries

cards.title: Premature retirement to join a Central PSU: retirement TA?
cards.answer: Not admissible. Rule 200 TA and DA do not apply to premature retirement for permanent absorption.
key: Applies to premature or voluntary retirement for absorption

cards.title: Called to a departmental enquiry after dismissal or removal
cards.answer: TA as for a tour from where the summons reaches you, capped at the cost from your home town.
key: Regulated by the pay of the post you last held
Applies after removal, dismissal or compulsory retirement

cards.title: Re-employed officer: CTG, baggage and car at the first posting
cards.answer: Yes, if the re-employment order came after you retired, from home town or SPR to the new place.
key: Order received before retirement: posting claim from the old duty station

cards.title: Release from re-employment: what travel do I get?
cards.answer: Free conveyance for you and your family to your SPR, limited to your home town.
key: No CTG, car or baggage, except 225 kg as on first appointment
Unclaimed retirement TA: claim within a year of release

cards.title: Dismissed or removed: free conveyance home?
cards.answer: The Army Chief, delegated to GOC-in-C, may allow a warrant to the station nearest your home, if you cannot pay.
key: Baggage limited to the railway free allowance
The authority orders the class in each case
watch: These powers are personal and cannot be delegated further

cards.title: Officer dies in service: family's TA and CTG
cards.answer: Family conveyance, CTG, baggage and vehicle are admissible as on a permanent move.
key: The unit OC prefers the claim to PCDA(O)
No family: baggage goes on warrant to the next of kin
Death on a course or TD: baggage from both stations, within scale
cards.cite: Rule 216(i)(a), (ii) and (iii), TR 2014; SAO 10/S/1976; MoD letter Air HQ/23952/304/PP&R4/988/D(Mov) dt 13-03-1979
cards.details: The vehicle's transport to the home town or SPR at government expense is also admissible on an officer's death in service.

cards.title: Family of a deceased officer settling away from the home town
cards.answer: Fares are paid for the shortest route from the officer's last HQ to the place they choose.
key: A member starting elsewhere: capped at the last-HQ-to-place cost
cards.cite: Rule 216(i)(b), TR 2014; MoD letter 12311/Q/Mov C/2065/D(Mov) dt 23-05-1981

cards.title: Death in operations: which office pays what?
cards.answer: Regional PCsDA audit and pay claims for transporting dead bodies. Send them there, not to PCDA(O).
key: Dependents may travel by the fastest means, including air, for customary rites
Two relatives of a battle casualty travel at government expense
cards.cite: Rule 216, 217A and 218B, TR 2014; MoD letter 12630/Mov C/3737/D(Mov)/08 dt 29-12-2008

cards.title: Family of a deceased officer: how baggage claims are checked
cards.answer: The Controlling Officer checks that the baggage really reached the family's chosen residence, within scale.
key: Checks are made before the travel expenses are allowed

cards.title: Transport allowance at double rate for blind or disabled personnel
cards.answer: Double the normal rate, at least Rs 1,000 a month plus DA.
key: Orthopaedic: 40% permanent disability of limbs, or 50% of both together
Recommended by the Head of Orthopaedics or Ophthalmology at a Military Hospital
watch: Stops during leave (casual leave excepted), joining time and suspension

cards.title: Transport allowance: when is it not paid?
cards.answer: Not where you have been given government transport.
key: Rates now follow the 7th-CPC pay level, not the TR grade pay
Not paid for a full calendar month of leave, training or tour

cards.title: Air tickets: book only through the three authorised agents
cards.answer: At government cost, buy air tickets only from BLCL, ATT or IRCTC. Rule effective from 01-01-2022.
key: The choice among the three is yours or your department's
DTS bookings are encouraged
watch: No exception for units without internet

cards.title: Can I fly a private airline on official travel?
cards.answer: Yes. Any airline, but book through the authorised agents.
key: Officers posted to Leh may use private airlines to Delhi on TD
Applies to TD and permanent moves

cards.title: How do I make sure my air ticket is the cheapest?
cards.answer: The agents must give the best available fare on the booking date, for your tour programme and entitlement.
key: A full-fare ticket is not what the agents are meant to give

cards.title: Agency fees and extras on air tickets
cards.answer: No agency or convenience fee is paid to the agents. Only the airline tariff is reimbursed.
key: Fees not included in the airline tariff are not payable
Service tax and cess charged on the ticket are reimbursable
Excess baggage and food bought with the ticket were disallowed in audit

cards.title: Ticket booked from an unauthorised agent in unavoidable circumstances
cards.answer: A senior authority can grant relaxation. Otherwise the fare is not admitted.
key: Financial Adviser of the Ministry or Department
Head of Department of Joint Secretary or Major General rank and above

cards.title: Frequent-flyer points earned on official tickets
cards.answer: They belong to the government. Using them for private travel can lead to departmental action.
key: Points earned by you or your family on official travel
The travel agents report accrued points quarterly

cards.title: Leave journey by air without LTC: can I claim the fare?
cards.answer: No. Air fare on leave is claimable only under LTC.
key: A leave journey outside LTC is at your own cost

cards.title: Sanctions must be signed in ink
cards.answer: Financial sanctions for rail, air, car and other moves must be signed in ink for audit.
key: Many copies: ink-sign the audit copies, others can be certified
A sanction without an ink signature is not accepted in audit

cards.title: Air class on LTC by pay level
cards.answer: Level 14 and above: business or club class. Levels 10 to 13B: economy class.
key: Rail-linked places by road: any public transport, up to the train fare
No rail link: AC bus, if entitled to AC II or above
You may always travel below your entitled class

cards.title: Travel to receive an award at Rashtrapati Bhavan
cards.answer: Recipients and entitled guests may fly to Delhi and back from their nearest airport.
key: Rail: highest class available, or the class used if lower
By road between rail-linked places: actual cost, up to the rail fare
Serving and retired officers; next of kin for posthumous awards

cards.title: Travel for admission to hospital
cards.answer: The class by rail and air is the same as for official tours.
key: Applies from 01-09-2008 under the 6th pay-commission orders
cards.cite: Rule 94 and Rule 108(2), TR 2014; MoD letter 12630/Mov C/3737/D(Mov)/08 dt 29-12-2008

cards.title: Reserved rail accommodation: certificate in the bill
cards.answer: State how many people travelled with you and certify their first class or AC II tickets, or give a NIL certificate.
key: Beforehand, the Station Master enters their ticket details
This lets Defence and the Railways adjust the fares between them

cards.title: Railway saloons: who may use them?
cards.answer: The Chief and Vice Chief of the Army Staff, when absolutely necessary. Army Commanders within their command.
key: Otherwise: a first class compartment of two or four berths
A four-berth AC compartment in special cases
The Chief's wife may travel free in the saloon on welfare visits
watch: At most six people, other than attendants, in the saloon

cards.title: I lost my LTC boarding passes
cards.answer: Boarding passes are mandatory for LTC claims. Get a certificate from the airline with the travel details.
key: It must give passenger name, date, class, seat number and amount paid
Submit it to PCDA(O) with the claim

cards.title: Taxi on LTC to a place with no public transport
cards.answer: Reimbursed up to 100 km, capped at the warrant cost, if no public or private transport exists.
key: Only when the taxi continues an air or train journey
Give a self-certificate with the taxi number
watch: Not reimbursed where private transport is available

cards.title: Ration money deducted from my TD claim
cards.answer: It is not deducted if you attach a non-drawal certificate from the QM of your serving unit.
key: The certificate must come from your own unit
watch: A certificate from the TD station is not valid

cards.title: Signing certificates on a claim: your responsibility
cards.answer: You are personally responsible for every fact in a certificate you sign, and liable for false statements.
key: Certify only what you know and believe
If the form does not fit, amend it or do not sign

cards.title: Declarations on a TD claim
cards.answer: Declare you used no warrant for the claimed portion, were present on DA days, and had no free board.
key: No railway warrant or concession voucher used for that portion
Actually present at the outstation on DA days; no leave taken
No free boarding or lodging provided

cards.title: Form 'D' for army officers in civil employ
cards.answer: Army officers in civil employ on service pay can use Form 'D'. The cost is debited to the civil department.
key: Issued by the nearest SSO or OC Station
Needs the Head of Department's certificate of service pay

cards.title: LTC to Lakshadweep: how to travel
cards.answer: Use SPORTS Samudram packages on Lakshadweep Administration ships. Only transport cost is reimbursed.
key: Claim the SPORTS website rate, or less if claimed less
Only the transportation cost, not accommodation
Fare follows your sea or river steamer entitlement
cards.cite: MoD letter 12647/LTC/SPORTS/Mov C/22/D(Mov)/2019 dt 22-03-2019; DoPT OM 31011/10/2017-Estt.A-IV dt 11-10-2018; CGDA letter AT/IV/4462/OA/DSD/AF dt 13-09-2017
cards.details: SPORTS must certify the fare components and that you and your family actually travelled. Applies from 11-10-2018.

cards.title: Leave encashment with LTC: how is it paid?
cards.answer: Ledger Wing pays it on your unit's Part II order, with your claim in the prescribed proforma.
key: The Part II order shows the warrant used or LTC availed
T Wing sections only deal with the LTC claim and title
cards.cite: Documentation Procedure for Publication of Part II Orders (Officers) 2014

cards.title: A TA claim pending for over a year
cards.answer: The Head of Department investigates. If genuine with valid reasons for delay, it is paid after usual checks.
key: Needs supporting documents
Paid by the Drawing and Disbursing or Accounts Officer

cards.title: Family travelled separately: how long do I have to claim?
cards.answer: Each journey has its own 60 days. Baggage and car claims run from delivery at the new station.
key: Dates are reckoned separately for each journey
Baggage and car: 60 days from delivery to you

cards.title: Which date counts as the date of submission?
cards.answer: Your own Controlling Officer: the date the claim reaches PCDA(O). Otherwise: the date it reaches your Controlling Officer.
key: A late treasury claim counts from your head of office's date
watch: These dating rules do not apply to LTC claims

cards.title: Field area posting: where does my family live?
cards.answer: Choose within two months of posting: keep old accommodation, move the family to SPR or home town, or to separated family quarters.
key: Two months, extendable to three in individual cases
Applies to officers posted to field areas

cards.title: Writing to PCDA(O): how?
cards.answer: Send queries through your CO or OC, one officer and one subject per letter, online on the PCDA(O) website.
key: Give rank, name, personal number and CDA(O) account number
No OP IMMEDIATE or PRIORITY labels
Only actual cases, not hypothetical ones

cards.title: Booking through DTS: advance and claim rules
cards.answer: DTS tickets count as an advance. The 60-day limit and penal interest apply.
key: Show ticket amounts on both credit and debit sides
Attach ticket copies and boarding passes
DTS also covers the DA and accommodation advance

cards.title: Applying for an advance online
cards.answer: Requisition TD, move or LTC advances online on the PCDA(O) website, separately for each.
key: Log in with your user ID and password
DTS claims go preferably through the DTS portal

cards.title: Refunding government dues to PCDA(O)
cards.answer: Remit by e-MRO or MRO payable to PCDA(O) Pune alone, quoting its RBI code and the reason.
key: e-MRO through the SBI portal is preferred
State on what account the amount is remitted
cards.details: PCDA(O) Pune RBI code: 4021000009.

cards.title: Courses held and attended locally: TA and DA?
cards.answer: Not payable for courses outside authorised Category A and B establishments. Daily Messing Allowance applies.
key: Officers on such courses get free rations

cards.title: Official travel abroad: tickets and claims
cards.answer: PCDA(O) does not pay air fare where an air warrant is mandatory, but does pay DA and incidentals.
key: PCDA(O) pays the advance and final claims for TA and DA abroad
PCDA New Delhi deals with air passage claims for ex-India travel
cards.cite: Para 242 of the Defence Audit Code

cards.title: Married after taking LTC this year: spouse's LTC?
cards.answer: Your spouse gets LTC both ways to the same leave station, within six months, even without you.
key: You must already have taken your own LTC for the year

cards.title: Officer under suspension: family's LTC?
cards.answer: You get no LTC, but your family can take LTC independently, if otherwise due.
key: A suspended officer cannot be granted leave

cards.title: Family's Home Town LTC: another station?
cards.answer: Only the home town, even if another station is nearer or cheaper.
key: Applies to the wife and other family members

cards.title: I travel on Form 'D' without LTC: my spouse's title?
cards.answer: Your spouse's independent title stands, if you claim no LTC for that journey.
key: Applies when you travel at your own expense using Form 'D'

cards.title: Changing my declared home town
cards.answer: Once declared, the home town is final. A change is allowed once in service, in exceptional cases.
key: Part II order quoting the AG's Branch letter; effective from its date
Head of Department's sanction, or MoD's, goes with the LTC claim
watch: Administrative authorities check warrants against your recorded home station
cards.cite: AO 22/02; SAO 4/S/88; CGDA clarification under Rule 190(5)(ii), TR 2014

cards.title: Form 'D': families, chair car, joining time
cards.answer: Unaccompanied families may use Form 'D' to any station. You may use it anywhere in the country on leave.
key: One extra set lets them break the journey, at your cost
AC chair car: Form 'D' at 60% of the actual fare
watch: Not during joining time, which is not leave
cards.cite: MoD letters PT/1203/NHQ/4851/D(Mov) dt 12-09-1974 and G/05492/Q Mov C/3853 D(Mov) dt 25-09-1979; CGDA letters 4007/AT-P and AT/IV/4425/1

cards.title: Leave from the islands: where does it start and end?
cards.answer: Your leave begins and ends at Embarkation HQ Kolkata or Chennai. Travel time counts as duty.
key: Applies to officers serving in A&N with homes on the mainland
Moved by the quickest means: ship or service aircraft
cards.cite: MoD letter A/14209/AG/PS2(B)/188-S-D(AG-ii) dt 16-02-1972, as amended

cards.title: Islands' residents serving on the mainland: free sea passage
cards.answer: Free sea passage by requisition between Kolkata or Chennai and the islands, and back.
key: Voyage time and enforced halts count as duty

cards.title: Risk and Hardship allowance: how it works
cards.answer: A location-based allowance from 22-02-2019. Your rate comes from your station's cell in the R&H matrix.
key: Station cells run from R1H1 (highest) to R3H3 (lowest)
Not paid with field, CI or Tough Location allowances
Your unit's eligibility comes from the Corps Notification
cards.cite: MoD (DMA) letter 8(3)/2017/D(Pay/Services) dt 21-04-2022; ADG PS letter C/7021/PAY/SAPCS/2022 dt 24-04-2022

cards.title: Claiming R&H: the Part II orders
cards.answer: Your unit publishes a CEASE order for the old rate and a GRANT order for the revised rate, from 22-02-2019.
key: The GRANT order quotes the unit's serial number in the Corps Notification
Retired or deceased cases: the unit publishes CEASE and GRANT orders
Send them to the Record Office or ORO
attach: Certificate that the 1994 and 2022 letters' conditions are met
Your station code, and the unit's entry in the Corps Notification
cards.cite: MoD letter 37269/AG/PS3(a)/90/D(Pay/Services) dt 13-01-1994; MoD (DMA) letter dt 21-04-2022

cards.title: R&H one cell down: which units?
cards.answer: Formation HQs up to Division, static units, MES, farms, recruiting, training centres, NCC and record offices.
key: One cell lower: R1H1 becomes R2H1; R1H2 becomes R2H2
77% of R1H2 drops to R2H2; 60% of R2H2 drops to R3H2
Only for locations listed in the 21-04-2022 letter
watch: If it would cut your existing allowance, the existing one continues

cards.title: My location fell to a lower R&H cell: what do I get?
cards.answer: A location that earned more before 21-04-2022 keeps it. You may claim the more beneficial allowance.
key: A location missing from the letter: you keep the existing allowance
Modified Field Area allowance continues at the present rate

cards.title: R&H at my location: does my Peace or Field status change?
cards.answer: No. R&H changes only the allowance. Your unit stays peace or field for every other purpose.
key: Peace units get no other Field Service Concessions
Field and CI units stay so for other purposes
HAA Cat III and HAFA at R1H1 rates are paid together

cards.title: Siachen: did R&H change my allowance?
cards.answer: No. Siachen does not appear in the 21-04-2022 letter, so your entitlement is unchanged.
key: Siachen Allowance continues as before

cards.title: Strategic Forces units: CFAA or R&H?
cards.answer: CFAA, not R&H, irrespective of location.
key: Publish Part II orders for CFAA and not for R&H

cards.title: R&H during absence: leave, TD, course, hospital
cards.answer: Paid through 20 days of casual leave and 3 months of TD. Not on annual leave or a course of 10 weeks or more.
key: Other leave, even a day, stops it; CL, sick leave excepted
A course does not count as TD for this purpose
A course over 10 weeks: no R&H
cards.cite: MoD letter 37269/AG/PS3(a)/90/D(Pay/Services) dt 13-01-1994; MoD letter PC-1(16)/2017/D(Pay/Services)/Pt.III dt 24-01-2020

cards.title: What is concurrent admissibility of allowances?
cards.answer: Two or more allowances paid at the same time, as the MoD letter of 29-02-2000 explains.
key: R&H itself is not paid with field, CI or Tough Location allowances

cards.title: HRA: who gets it, and at which place's rate?
cards.answer: Paid when no government accommodation is allotted. Peace posting: place-of-posting rate. Field posting: your SPR's rate.
key: No government accommodation at your present or previous duty station
Any accommodation, even below your entitlement, stops HRA
Single officers qualify only if dependents incur rent
cards.cite: MoD letter 1(5)/97/D(Pay/Services) dt 02-11-1997, modified 29-09-1999; MoD letter 1(2)/2021-D(Q&C) dt 08-04-2022

cards.title: HRA rate by city class
cards.answer: X cities 24%, Y cities 16%, Z cities 8% of basic pay, from 01-07-2017.
key: 27%, 18% and 9% once DA crosses 25%
30%, 20% and 10% once DA crosses 50%
Basic pay excludes NPA, MSP and special pay
cards.details: X cities: Delhi, Greater Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Pune. Unlisted towns are Z. Faridabad, Ghaziabad, Noida, Gurgaon keep Delhi rates; Shillong, Goa, Port Blair, Jalandhar Cantt and Mathura-Vrindavan are Y.

cards.title: What is an SPR?
cards.answer: Your Selected Place of Residence: where your family lives when you are posted to a field, modified field or concessional area.
key: Applies where families are not permitted
Options: keep old quarters, move to a chosen place, or home town
Can be your last station, home town, SF station or any station

cards.title: Declaring your SPR: deadline and how
cards.answer: Within 60 days of posting, or 90 days with the Station Commander's approval. Publish a Part II order.
key: Declare on every field posting, even if SPR is your home town
The Part II order is the declaration; there is no fixed format
Missed deadline: baggage, family move and HRA claims are refused

cards.title: Can I change my SPR?
cards.answer: SPR once declared is final. It may be changed once, in extreme circumstances.
key: Applies to the SPR you declared on posting

cards.title: Family moved home for want of quarters: can they join me at Government cost?
cards.answer: Rule 85A allows a one-time free move to join you once Government married accommodation is allotted.
key: Only for Government-built married accommodation
Baggage is limited to what was first moved to the SPR

cards.title: HRA for a single officer with dependents
