cards.answer: Admissible if the dependents keep incurring rent. Their Part II order (DEPNDNT) must be notified.
key: Brothers: until 25, or until earning Rs 9,000 a month
Sisters: until marriage, 25, or earning Rs 9,000 a month
Parents also count as dependents
cards.cite: MoD letter 12647/LTC/Mov C/2970/D(Mov)/08 dt 17-12-2008; MoD letter 17(01)/2016-D(Pen/Pol) dt 29-10-2016

cards.title: HRA during study leave
cards.answer: Yes, at the rate for the study-leave station, if no Government quarters are vacant there.
key: Not if you occupy any Government or hired accommodation

cards.title: Reserved accommodation in a concessional area: HRA?
cards.answer: HRA is paid for your SPR or home town if Government quarters are not available there.
key: Licence fee is charged on the reserved accommodation at the duty station
Declare the SPR within 2 months of posting, not of TORS

cards.title: HRA while staying in the mess
cards.answer: Paid at the duty-station rate if your family lives at another station.
key: Family at the same station on private arrangement: not paid
Unless you certify you stay in the mess for service reasons
attach: Certificate that your family is not residing with you in the mess

cards.title: HRA Part II order: the CO's certificate
cards.answer: Since 08-04-2022 the CO certifies the claim in place of a station NAC.
key: Accommodation must not stay vacant while you draw HRA
Certificate states posting type, no Government quarters and family address
City class of the HRA station is stated
cards.cite: MoD letter 1(2)/2021-D(Q&C) dt 08-04-2022; IHQ letter C/7036/HRA/SAPCS/2022 dt 06-09-2022

cards.title: HRA in the gap between two postings
cards.answer: Claim HRA at the new station's rate until you register for married accommodation.
key: You must have vacated your previous accommodation
No Government quarters may stay vacant because of your claim

cards.title: Both spouses serving: HRA or accommodation
cards.answer: Each is entitled to accommodation or HRA at their own station.
key: Both posted in the field: each may claim at their own SPR
A field-posted spouse cannot claim SPR HRA if the other has quarters

cards.title: Accommodation allotted but not occupied
cards.answer: Take possession within 10 days. After that, HRA stops for 20 days from allotment.
key: Licence fee is charged for the 10 days
After 20 days, HRA can be allowed on a competent authority's NAC
Refusing any married accommodation bars HRA

cards.title: Separated family accommodation at hard non-military stations
cards.answer: Officers at listed hard stations may get separated family accommodation at their last duty station.
key: GREF, NCC and recruiting units have their own station lists
If none is available: hired accommodation or rent reimbursement
From a field area: family moves to SPR at cost
cards.cite: MoD letter 18147/DGBR/E-2A(T&C)/D(Q&C) dt 20-10-1997; MoD letter 6731/SFA/DGNCC/ADM(A-2)/4727/D(Q&C) dt 22-10-1991

cards.title: Leave encashment with LTC: the conditions
cards.answer: Up to 10 days of annual leave per LTC, 60 days in all over your career, including any re-employment.
key: At least 30 days of annual leave must remain to your credit
Allowed even if only your family travels on the LTC
No limit on spells; can come from leave kept for encashment
cards.details: Both spouses serving: each can encash up to 60 days. Re-employed officers can encash with LTC up to the same 60-day total.

cards.title: Claiming leave encashment with LTC: documents
cards.answer: Forward the Part II order notifying LVELTC to PCDA(O) well ahead, and then submit the LTC journey claim.
key: The order names LTC type, place of visit and leave period
You can claim 60 days before the outward journey
watch: Without the LTC journey claim, the encashment is recovered

cards.title: How is LTC leave encashment calculated?
cards.answer: (Basic pay + NPA, if any + DA) x days / 30, on the date of the journey.
key: NPA counts only for medical officers
MSP is not included
Applies from 01-01-2016

cards.title: Is LTC leave encashment taxable?
cards.answer: Yes, it is taxable.
key: Treat it as taxable income in your tax computation

cards.title: CEA and hostel subsidy: how much?
cards.answer: CEA Rs 33,750 a year per child; hostel subsidy up to Rs 1,01,250 a year, from 01-04-2024.
key: Divyaang child (40% or more): double CEA, Rs 67,500 a year
Hostel subsidy: actual lodging and boarding cost, or the ceiling if lower
Both can be claimed together
cards.cite: MoD letter 1(23)/2017/D(Pay/Services) dt 02-08-2018; DoPT OM A-27012/02/2017-Estt(AL) dt 16-07-2018
cards.details: The base was Rs 2,250 and Rs 6,750 a month. The order says both rise 25% each time DA rises 50%; x1.25 from 01-01-2024 gives the figures above.

cards.title: Which children qualify for CEA?
cards.answer: Your two eldest surviving children, up to age 20 or class 12, whichever is earlier.
key: Twins or multiple birth at the second birth: all are covered
Divyaang children: up to age 22
From AY 2023-24: up to three classes before Class 1

cards.title: CEA claim: documents and Part II codes
cards.answer: A bonafide certificate from the school and your self-declaration, with a Part II order.
key: Divyaang child: also a disability certificate from the competent authority
Twins: occurrence code RIMBCEAT; a divyaang twin: RIMBCEAD
attach: Self-attested report card or fee receipt, if no certificate

cards.title: Hostel subsidy: when and with what documents
cards.answer: For a child in a residential school at least 50 km from your home. Claim once a year.
key: The school certificate must state the lodging and boarding cost
HOSTSUB Part II order and your self-declaration
watch: Both spouses in service: only one can claim

cards.title: Officer dies in service: CEA and hostel subsidy for the children
cards.answer: Admissible if the spouse is not in Government or similar service.
key: Paid until the officer would have reached age 60
Child's limit still applies: class 12, age 20, or 22 if divyaang

cards.title: CEA: retirement, failing a class, and leave
cards.answer: Retiring mid-year: CEA runs to the end of that academic year. Failing a class does not stop it.
key: Same class in another school after passing it: not reimbursable
Distance learning counts; leave and suspension do not stop it
Dies-non periods are excluded

cards.title: OPD medical claim returned: the usual reasons
cards.answer: Check for missing papers, a late sanction, a late claim or a bill not countersigned.
key: Missing: NAC, medical case sheet or the AO 32/81 appendix
Missing: dependent Part II order or dependent ID card
NAC or sanction taken after the test or investigation
watch: Special sanction under DFPDS-2016 Sec 5.7 missing where needed
Claim filed late, or the contingent bill not countersigned

cards.title: Medical claim for an indoor patient
cards.answer: The Regional CDA handles it. PCDA(O) deals only with OPD claims without hospitalisation.
key: Send hospital-stay claims to your Regional CDA

cards.title: Special investigation at a private hospital: is an MH or CH NAC enough?
cards.answer: Yes. An NAC from a Military Hospital or Command Hospital is sufficient.
key: No separate NAC from the private hospital is needed

cards.title: My medical claim was admitted for less than I claimed
cards.answer: Claims are passed at the CGHS rate list.
key: Charges above the CGHS rate are not reimbursed

cards.title: Dependents for medical claims
cards.answer: A dependent has income under Rs 9,000 plus DA a month. A spouse needs no dependency test.
key: Income from all sources, including pension, counts
Attach the dependent Part II order or ID card issued before treatment

cards.title: Medical claim: time limit and condonation
cards.answer: Submit within six months of treatment or discharge. Later claims need condonation.
key: The old three-month limit was extended to six months
Condonation powers follow the 1999 OM

cards.title: Transport allowance rates by pay level
cards.answer: Levels 10 to 13A: Rs 7,200 plus DA in listed cities, Rs 3,600 plus DA elsewhere.
key: Level 14 and above: Rs 15,750 plus DA; rates from 01-07-2017
Level 14 and above with a car: choose car or allowance
Not paid if Government transport is provided for commuting
cards.cite: MoD letter 12630/Tpt.A/Mov C/246/D(Mov)/17 dt 15-09-2017; MoF OM 11-1/2016/E.IIB dt 10-04-2018
cards.details: Higher-rate cities: Delhi, Greater Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Ahmedabad, Surat, Gandhinagar, Patna, Kochi, Kozhikode, Indore, Nagpur, Jaipur, Coimbatore, Ghaziabad, Kanpur, Lucknow.

cards.title: Transport allowance at double rate: how to claim
cards.answer: Visually impaired, orthopaedically handicapped, deaf, hearing impaired and spinal-deformity officers get double.
key: Medical certificate from the relevant specialist at an MH
Sanction of the competent authority under Appendix I
watch: Partially blind personnel do not get the double rate
cards.cite: MoD letter 12630/Tpt.A/Mov C/78/D(Mov)/18 dt 17-07-2018; MoF OM 21/3/2017-E.IIB dt 12-07-2018; Rule 230A TR

cards.title: Transport allowance during leave
cards.answer: Not paid for a calendar month wholly covered by leave. Part-month leave does not reduce it.
key: Annual or furlough leave not covering a full month: full rate
Study leave: not admissible

cards.title: Transport allowance during TD, tour or a course
cards.answer: Nothing for a calendar month wholly spent on TD or tour. Under a month: the full allowance.
key: TD over 180 days: rate of the new city class
Course over 10 weeks: course-station rate, if no RMA is paid
attach: CO or OC certificate that no transport was provided during training

cards.title: Transport allowance during suspension
cards.answer: None for a full calendar month of suspension, even if later treated as duty.
key: Part of a month: reduced proportionately

cards.title: Transport allowance on deputation abroad or in Bhutan
cards.answer: No. It is paid only within India.
key: Not on deputation to a UN mission
Not while serving in Bhutan and drawing Bhutan Compensatory Allowance

cards.title: Documents needed for a personal number change or extension of service
cards.answer: A letter from the MS branch, DGMS or DGAFMS covering the event is what the pay office warrants.
key: Personal number allotment or change: MS branch letter
Extension of service: MS branch letter

cards.title: Documents needed to open an account on re-employment
cards.answer: Re-employment needs the Part II order, your bank particulars and an MS branch letter.
key: Retired officers re-employed open a fresh pay account
attach: Part II order of re-employment
Bank details with a cancelled cheque
MS branch letter
cards.cite: Form A (AO 03/03) procedure under the Pay and Allowances Regulations for the Army

cards.title: Documents needed to reopen the account on re-commission
cards.answer: Casualty-code Part II order, bank details, PAN card, Form A and the MS branch letter.
key: Earlier account number is reactivated on re-commission
attach: Part II order notifying the casualty code
Bank details with a cancelled cheque
PAN card, Form A, MS branch letter
watch: Territorial Army commission also needs the TA number allotment sanction
cards.cite: Form A (AO 03/03) procedure under the Pay and Allowances Regulations for the Army

cards.title: Documents needed on reversion from deputation or secondment
cards.answer: Part II order with the right casualty code, bank details, MS branch letter and last pay certificate.
key: Reversion from deputation: casualty code REVDEP
Reversion from secondment: casualty code REVSECND
attach: Cancelled cheque, last pay certificate, MS branch letter
PAN card and Form A on secondment
cards.cite: Form A (AO 03/03) procedure under the Pay and Allowances Regulations for the Army

cards.title: Promotion pay fixation: which option and how to opt
cards.answer: By default pay is fixed on the promotion date. You may opt for fixation on the next increment date.
key: Opt within 3 months of promotion or IHQ order
Part II order with occurrence code OPTFXDNI is needed
attach: Option form signed by you and countersigned
watch: Not available for deputation, direct recruitment or ad-hoc promotion
cards.cite: Army Pay Rules 2017 (7th CPC), option for pay fixation on promotion; MoD OM 1(20)/2017/D(Pay/Services) dt 26-02-2019

cards.title: Can I change or late-file my promotion pay fixation option?
cards.answer: No. The option is final once made, and a late option is not accepted.
key: No option in time: pay is fixed from the date of promotion
No later amendment of an option already exercised
cards.cite: Army Pay Rules 2017 (7th CPC), option for pay fixation on promotion

cards.title: Why was pay recovered after I opted for DNI fixation?
cards.answer: The default fixation from the date of promotion is cancelled up to the next increment date.
key: Promotion date to DNI: next higher cell in the new level
On DNI: two notional increments in the old level, then fix
Earlier default fixation is recovered up to DNI
cards.cite: Army Pay Rules 2017 (7th CPC), option for pay fixation on promotion

cards.title: When is my first increment after promotion fixation?
cards.answer: After 6 months, on the next 1 January or 1 July. Later increments follow every 12 months.
key: Applies to promotions on or after 01-01-2016
Only one increment a year: 1 January or 1 July
cards.cite: Army Pay Rules 2017 (7th CPC); SRO 12(E) dt 03-05-2017

cards.title: What document goes with the OPTFXDNI Part II order?
cards.answer: The option form signed by you and countersigned by the competent authority.
key: Both documents are forwarded together to PCDA(O)
cards.cite: Army Pay Rules 2017 (7th CPC), option for pay fixation on promotion

cards.title: Special increments for sports: who qualifies and how many?
cards.answer: Excellence at national or international events: 1 increment for national, 2 for international, maximum 5 in a career.
key: National: first to third in athletics, first only in games
Starts from the 1st of the month after the event
Government sanction needed in each case
cards.cite: MoD letter B/25571/AG/PS-3(b)/3335/D(Pay/Services) dt 04-10-1991; MoD letter 30(13)/2007/D(Pay/Services) dt 30-08-2017 and 24-08-2018, corrigendum dt 17-09-2021
cards.details: Referees and umpires accepted by an international federation can get two increments per event, within the same five-increment cap.

cards.title: Do sports increments count for pay fixation or allowances?
cards.answer: No. They do not count for pay fixation, retirement benefits or allowances such as HRA.
key: Paid as personal pay by level
Not counted for promotion fixation

cards.title: Time limit to claim a sports special increment
cards.answer: Claim within 6 months of the end of the sporting event.
key: Counted from completion of the overall event

cards.title: Technical Allowance: who gets Tier I and Tier II?
cards.answer: Technically qualified officers on full-time technical duties. Tier I after the young officers' technical course; Tier II after a prescribed course (one course per tier).
key: Tier I base Rs 3,000 a month from 01-04-2018
Tier II base Rs 4,500 a month from 01-04-2018
Tier II needs substantive Captain rank and a Tier II course
cards.cite: MoD letter 1(16)/2017/D(Pay/Services) dt 18-09-2017 and 14-09-2018; MoD letter 15(49)/2017/Tech Allce/D(GS-II) dt 25-06-2018
cards.details: Both limbs apply. Tier II needs substantive Captain rank and a prescribed Tier II course, with Service HQ detailment. Not for AMC, ADC, AEC, MNS or non-technical officers.

cards.title: Who is not entitled to Technical Allowance?
cards.answer: AMC, ADC, AEC and MNS officers, and non-technical officers, get neither tier.
key: Also not paid if posted against a non-technical post
Courses with no direct link to duties do not qualify

cards.title: Technical Allowance for re-employed officers
cards.answer: Only while you are working full time on technical and upkeep duties and meet every eligibility condition.
key: Re-employment alone does not give the allowance

cards.title: Documents for Technical Allowance Tier I
cards.answer: Part II order GTDTECI with a deployment certificate and a qualification certificate from the line directorate.
key: Claim goes with the Part II order
attach: Part II order notifying GTDTECI
CO or OC certificate of full-time technical deployment
One-time line directorate certificate with first claim

cards.title: Documents for Technical Allowance Tier II
cards.answer: Part II order GTDTECII, claim routed via the line directorate, deployment certificate and a course detailment certificate.
key: Claim is routed through the line directorate
attach: Part II order notifying GTDTECII
CO or OC full-time deployment certificate
Service HQ detailment certificate for listed courses
cards.cite: MoD letter 15(49)/2017/Tech Allce/D(GS-II) dt 25-06-2018; CGDA letter ARMY/BR/OFF./ALLOW/1223/Misc dt 07-10-2019

cards.title: Specialist Allowance: who is eligible?
cards.answer: AMC and ADC officers graded by DGAFMS as Graded or Classified Specialist or Consultant, who are in the pool or hold a specialist post.
key: Graded Rs 3,600, Classified Rs 4,500, Consultant Rs 5,400 monthly
Base rates from 01-07-2017; rise 25% per 50% DA
Not for Brigadier and above (AMC) or Major General and above (ADC)
cards.cite: Rules 88 to 91, Pay and Allowances Regulations for the Army; MoD letter 1(16)/2017/D(Pay/Services) dt 18-09-2017

cards.title: When is Specialist Allowance not payable?
cards.answer: In transit between specialist posts, under arrest or suspension, on study leave or a course of 10 weeks or more.
key: Restored after suspension only if honourably acquitted
Still payable in these cases if you stay in the specialist pool
cards.cite: Rules 88 to 91, Pay and Allowances Regulations for the Army

cards.title: Post Graduate Allowance: who gets it?
cards.answer: AMC and ADC officers with a postgraduate degree or diploma who are not eligible for Specialist Allowance.
key: Degree Rs 2,250 and diploma Rs 1,350 a month
Base rates from 01-07-2017; rise 25% per 50% DA
Must be on the DGAFMS pool list
attach: Part II order citing the DGAFMS letter

cards.title: Who gets Flying Allowance?
cards.answer: Army Aviation officers in sanctioned posts of the permanent aviation cadre, including those on staff or ERE duty.
key: Base Rs 25,000 a month for all ranks from 01-07-2017
Rises 25% each time DA rises by 50%
Must meet the eligibility conditions
cards.cite: Rule 164, Pay and Allowances Regulations for the Army; MoD letter 1(16)/2017/D(Pay/Services) dt 18-09-2017 and 14-09-2018

cards.title: Army aviator at Siachen: Siachen or Flying Allowance?
cards.answer: One or the other, at your choice. Both are not paid together.
key: Rule applies from 01-04-1999

cards.title: Flying Allowance during a course of 10 weeks or more
cards.answer: Payable for a non-flying course if your vacancy stays unfilled and you return to AOP duty.
key: Both conditions must hold

cards.title: How Flying Allowance is claimed each month
cards.answer: Monthly, on a Part II order granting it, with the prescribed certificates.
key: Publish grant and stoppage in the same Part II order
Claim the full month in one order
cards.cite: MoD letter B/26243/AG/PS3(a)401/S/D(Pay/Services) dt 06-05-1982 as amended

cards.title: How much Flying Allowance goes to the DSOP Fund?
cards.answer: Two-fifths of the allowance is credited to your DSOP Fund account.
key: This is on top of your own DSOP subscription
cards.cite: MoD letter B/26243/AG/PS3(a)401/S/D(Pay/Services) dt 06-05-1982 as amended

cards.title: Parachute Allowance: who qualifies?
cards.answer: Operational parachutists in posts authorised on the unit establishment. Administrative posts qualify only if the post needs a parachutist.
key: Base Rs 10,500 a month for all ranks from 01-07-2017
Rises 25% each time DA rises by 50%
Paid on top of normal pay and allowances
cards.cite: Rules 94, 95 and 100 to 101, Pay and Allowances Regulations for the Army; MoD letter 1(16)/2017/D(Pay/Services) dt 18-09-2017

cards.title: Is Parachute Allowance paid on annual leave?
cards.answer: Yes. It continues during annual leave.
key: Yearly refresher course with two jumps keeps it going
cards.cite: Rule 105, Pay and Allowances Regulations for the Army

cards.title: Para Reserve Allowance: who gets it and who can move to the reserve?
cards.answer: Parachute reservists in non-parachute units, from posting as reservist until struck off the reserve.
key: Transfer needs 3 years in a Para unit as trained parachutist
Age under 35; above that needs administrative sanction
Base Rs 2,625 a month from 01-07-2017
cards.cite: Rule 111, Pay and Allowances Regulations for the Army; MoD letter 1(16)/2017/D(Pay/Services) dt 18-09-2017
cards.details: Reservists must attend a refresher course with at least two jumps each training year. When called up for para service or annual training they draw full Parachute Allowance. Not paid together with Special Force Allowance. Rate rises 25% each time DA rises by 50%.

cards.title: Do I claim Ration Money Allowance myself?
cards.answer: No. The unit notifies it by Part II order GTDRSHNA, which must be followed by a stop order.
key: Grant order GTDRSHNA, then cessation STPRSHNA
Long leaves of 180 days or more: unit publishes quarterly in arrears
attach: Certificates: no free ration, no DA or DMA, not hospitalised
cards.cite: Rule 174(B), Defence Service Regulations, Pay and Allowances (Officers); SAPCS letter C/7099/Policy/SAPCS/2022 dt 01-04-2022

cards.title: Ration Money Allowance during study leave
cards.answer: Yes, study leave in India at a non-military station with no ration drawing facility.
key: Station must be notified by Government
Also payable on annual leave, sick leave on full pay, furlough, maternity
cards.cite: Rule 174(B), Defence Service Regulations, Pay and Allowances (Officers)

cards.title: HAFA, CFA and CMFA in a static unit
cards.answer: Not admissible to static units such as military farms, MES, recruiting offices, training centres and NCC units.
key: TA units get it only when embodied
Record offices and cantonment units also static
Hospitals, EME workshops and supply depots count as non-static
cards.details: Base rates from 01-07-2017: HAFAA Rs 16,900, CFAA Rs 10,500, CMFAA Rs 6,300 a month. Each rises 25% when DA rises by 50%.

cards.title: Field area allowance while on leave from the field area
cards.answer: Only casual leave (up to 20 days) and sick list or transit (up to 15 days) keep it going.
key: Annual, maternity, furlough, study, child care, sick leave: not paid
TD up to 3 months, if you return to field area
cards.cite: MoD letter 1(16)/2017/D(Pay/Services)/Pt.III dt 24-01-2020; MoD letter 37269/AG/PS3(a)/90/D(Pay/Services) dt 13-01-1994

cards.title: Is field area allowance restored after leave automatically?
cards.answer: No. It restarts only after a Part II order granting it is published after you rejoin.
key: Stopped when you go on leave

cards.title: Siachen Allowance during leave or temporary duty
cards.answer: Up to 14 days on sick list, casual leave or TD keeps it if you return. Annual leave stops it from day one.
key: Base Rs 42,500 a month from 01-07-2017
Rises 25% each time DA rises by 50%
Starts on arrival; ends the day after you leave
cards.cite: MoD letter 1(2)/91/D(Pay/Services) dt 01-05-1991 as amended; MoD letter 1(16)/2017/D(Pay/Services) dt 18-09-2017

cards.title: Siachen Allowance with other allowances
cards.answer: Payable with HAFA and with SCCIA. Not payable with High Altitude Allowance or Flying Allowance.
key: HAUCA and SCCIA can be claimed together
Siachen and HAUCA cannot be claimed together
Aviators choose Siachen or Flying
cards.cite: MoD letter 1(2)/91/D(Pay/Services) dt 01-05-1991 as amended; MoD letter 3(4)/97/D(Pay/Services) dt 28-05-1999

cards.title: Transit or guest house stay on posting: when reimbursed?
cards.answer: When you applied for accommodation, got none, and stayed in a government guest house at the new station.
key: Station Headquarters NAC (no accommodation certificate) is needed
Guest house must be at the place of posting
HRA is not paid for those days

cards.title: Documents for transit accommodation charges
cards.answer: Part II order with code REIMACCO from the new unit, an NAC and the original rent receipt.
key: The new unit, not the old one, publishes the order
attach: REIMACCO Part II order
NAC from Station HQ
Original rent receipt

cards.title: How long are transit accommodation charges reimbursed?
cards.answer: For a maximum of six months.
key: Reimbursed in line with how HRA is paid
Needs the new unit's Part II order, certificate and rent receipt
watch: No HRA for the stay; the payment is taxable

cards.title: Is transit accommodation reimbursement taxable, and is HRA also paid?
cards.answer: It is taxable because it replaces HRA. HRA is not paid for the same stay.
key: Certify that you will not claim HRA for those days

cards.title: Which pay level does each Army rank draw?
cards.answer: Lieutenant draws Level 10, Captain 10B, Major 11, Lieutenant Colonel 12A, Colonel 13, Brigadier 13A and Major General 14.
key: Lieutenant General: Level 15, or 16 for HAG+
Vice Chief and Army Commanders: Level 17
Chief of Army Staff: Level 18
cards.cite: SRO 17(E) dt 06-07-2017 (Army Officers Pay Rules 2017 pay matrix)
cards.details: Military Nursing Service uses its own levels (10, 10A, 10B, 11, 12, 12B, 13B). NCC whole-time lady officers use 10, 10B, 11 and 12. Pay is drawn in the level of the rank held substantively.

cards.title: Who do the 7th CPC Army pay rules cover?
cards.answer: Army officers in service on 01-01-2016, including AMC, ADC, RVC, TA when embodied, cadets, and later joiners.
key: Rules apply from 01-01-2016
NCC and MNS officers have their own rules
cards.cite: Army Officers Pay Rules 2017, SRO 12(E) dt 03-05-2017; SRO 21(E) dt 14-07-2017 for MNS
cards.details: NCC whole-time officers follow MoD letter 4/43/2017-D(GS-VI)/2018 dt 16-10-2018. MSP is not admissible to NCC officers.

cards.title: How was pay fixed in the 7th CPC matrix on 01-01-2016?
cards.answer: Old basic pay times 2.57, rounded, then placed at that cell or the next higher cell of your level.
key: If below the level's first cell, pay is first cell
AMC, ADC, RVC with NPA: add DA on old NPA before locating
Excess of old pay over new is personal pay
cards.cite: Army Officers Pay Rules 2017, SRO 12(E) dt 03-05-2017, rule 7
cards.details: Basic pay means pay band pay plus grade pay. Example: Major with Rs 32,720 gets 84,090 and is fixed at Rs 85,300 in Level 11. Personal pay is absorbed in future increases.

cards.title: Can I still change my 2016 option for revised pay?
cards.answer: No. The option was one-time and final; the last window closed on 01-02-2020.
key: Officers commissioned from 01-01-2016 had no option
No option in time meant revised pay from 01-01-2016
cards.cite: Army Officers Pay Rules 2017, SRO 12(E) dt 03-05-2017; MoD letter 1(29)/2017/D(Pay/Services) dt 06-08-2019
cards.details: Original window was 180 days from notification. Those out of India, suspended, deceased or released had relaxed rules. The 2019 relaxation let officers revise an earlier option up to 01-02-2020.

cards.title: Military Service Pay: who gets it and how much?
cards.answer: Army officers up to Brigadier get Rs 15,500 a month. It counts as pay for DA and pension.
key: MNS officers up to Brigadier: Rs 10,800
Not admissible to NCC officers
NPA is never calculated on MSP
cards.cite: Army Officers Pay Rules 2017, SRO 12(E) dt 03-05-2017; SRO 21(E) dt 14-07-2017 for MNS

cards.title: Pay for gentlemen and lady cadets, and for those commissioned from the ranks
cards.answer: Cadets get a fixed stipend of Rs 56,100 a month. On commissioning, pay starts at the first cell of Level 10.
key: Training is not commissioned service
Allowance arrears for training period are paid
From ranks: old pay and allowances during training
cards.cite: Army Officers Pay Rules 2017, SRO 12(E) dt 03-05-2017, rule 10
cards.details: Applies at IMA, OTA Chennai and Gaya, and Cadets Training Wings at CME. For those from the ranks, on commissioning the difference between stipend plus DA and what was drawn is paid as a lump sum.

cards.title: What is starting pay on commission from 01-01-2016?
cards.answer: Lieutenant starts at Rs 56,100, cell 1 of Level 10. In AMC, ADC and RVC a Lieutenant starts at cell 2.
key: AMC, ADC, RVC Lieutenant: Rs 57,800
AMC, ADC, RVC Captain: Rs 61,300, cell 1 of Level 10B
cards.cite: Army Officers Pay Rules 2017, SRO 12(E) dt 03-05-2017, rule 11

cards.title: On which date is my annual increment due?
cards.answer: Commissioned or promoted 2 Jan to 1 Jul: increment each 1 Jan. Commissioned or promoted 2 Jul to 1 Jan: each 1 Jul.
key: Only one increment a year
Pay revised on 01-01-2016: first increment 01-07-2016
Each increment moves one cell down in your level
cards.cite: Army Officers Pay Rules 2017, SRO 12(E) dt 03-05-2017

cards.title: How is pay fixed on promotion from 01-01-2016?
cards.answer: Add one increment in the old level, then place yourself at the same figure or next higher cell in the new level.
key: Default method if you take no option
Maj Gen: add one increment plus MSP, then locate cell
Lt Gen not promoted Army Commander: Level 17, non-functional
cards.cite: Army Officers Pay Rules 2017, SRO 12(E) dt 03-05-2017, rule 12
cards.details: Example: a Lt Colonel drawing Rs 1,53,500 gets one increment to Rs 1,58,100; Level 13 has no such cell, so the next higher figure, Rs 1,60,600, applies. The Level 17 non-functional pay counts for financial benefits only, not privileges of the Army Commander appointment.

cards.title: Promotion fixation on next increment date: how the option works
cards.answer: Until DNI you sit at the next cell in the new level. On DNI you get two old-level increments, then re-fix.
key: Not available for deputation, direct entry or ad-hoc promotion
First increment in new rank comes after 6 months
Decide within 3 months; it is final
cards.cite: Army Pay Rules 2017; MoD OM 1(20)/2017/D(Pay/Services) dt 26-02-2019; MoF DoE OM 4-21/2017-IC/E.IIIA dt 28-11-2019
cards.details: Those promoted 01-01-2016 to 26-02-2019 had 6 months from 26-02-2019 to opt; promotions after that have 3 months. Example: Captain at Rs 69,000 promoted 10-12-2022 to Major, DNI 01-01-2023: Rs 69,400 until DNI, Rs 73,600 on DNI, Rs 75,800 on 01-07-2023.

cards.title: Pay when commissioned with antedate on or after 01-01-2016
cards.answer: Pay is fixed notionally from the antedate, with increments added; the result is your pay on commission.
key: Increments in the antedate period are notional
Next increment may fall soon after commission
cards.cite: Army Officers Pay Rules 2017, SRO 12(E) dt 03-05-2017
cards.details: Example: commissioned 02-03-2016 with two years antedate from 02-03-2014. Notional pay Rs 15,600 rises to 56,100 in 7th CPC; the 01-07-2016 increment takes pay to Rs 57,800.

cards.title: Stepping up pay of a senior drawing less than a junior
cards.answer: Senior promoted before 01-01-2016 and drawing less than a junior promoted later is stepped up to the junior's pay.
key: Same arm or service, same rank, same level
Not if the junior's lead comes from advance increments
Effective from the junior's promotion date
cards.cite: MoD ID Note 1(12)/2020/D(Pay/Services) dt 19-11-2020; MoF OM 4-21/2017-IC/E.IIIA dt 28-11-2019; DoPT OM 4/3/2017-Estt(Pay-I) dt 26-10-2018
cards.details: At promotion the senior must have drawn at least what the junior drew. Next increment falls due after the usual qualifying service from the date of re-fixation. A second limb covers seniors promoted on or after 01-01-2016.

cards.title: Bunching of pay stages at 7th CPC fixation
cards.answer: If two officers' old pays were 3% apart but land in one cell, the higher one gets an extra increment.
key: Only for rank, arm or service peers on direct fixation
No further benefit from later bunching
Not a seniority matter
cards.cite: MoD letter 1(22)/2017/D(Pay/Services) dt 06-10-2017; MoF DoE OM 1-6/2016-IC dt 07-09-2016 and 03-08-2017
cards.details: Compare pays in the old structure, not the new matrix. Example: Rs 37,400 and Rs 38,770 (3% apart) with Rs 8,000 grade pay both fix at Rs 1,21,200; the second moves to Rs 1,24,800.

cards.title: Non Practising Allowance for AMC, ADC and RVC
cards.answer: NPA is 20% of basic pay in the pay matrix from 01-07-2017, capped so pay plus MSP plus NPA stays within Rs 2,37,500.
key: Lieutenant (AMC) and AMC(NT) officers not eligible
Counts as pay for DA, pension, retirement benefits
Not counted in basic pay for HRA from 01-07-2017
cards.cite: Rule 171, Pay and Allowances Regulations for the Army; MoD letter 4(10)/2017/D(Med) dt 28-09-2017; MoD letter 3(1)/2015-D(Q&C) dt 11-10-2017
cards.details: NPA is paid during study leave. It is not calculated on MSP.

cards.title: When does pay start on first commission?
cards.answer: From the date of commission. For NDA, IMA or OTA officers it cannot start more than 30 days before you report for duty.
key: MNS officers: pay from date of joining only
Field-area first posting: date you report to the unit
Medical officers: date you report for duty, not transit camp
cards.cite: Rules 1 and 2, Pay and Allowances Regulations for the Army
cards.details: Newly commissioned officers who report to a transit camp after 21 days of joining leave are treated as reported for duty. Late reporting after the fixed date must be regularised. Send Form A (AO 03/03) within 7 days of reporting, signed by you and countersigned by the CO or OC.

cards.title: Does a change of name or spelling affect my pay records?
cards.answer: Yes. Even a spelling change counts as a change of name and needs a Gazette notification to be published in Part II.
key: Cover the Part II order with the Gazette number and date

cards.title: Pay of cadets and trainees during pre-commission training
cards.answer: Cadets get a fixed stipend. Trainees from the ranks keep their old rank pay, with a lump-sum balance on commissioning.
key: Stipend Rs 56,100 a month from 01-01-2016
Stipend becomes pay on successful commissioning
Training period is not commissioned service
cards.cite: Army Officers Pay Rules 2017, SRO 12(E) dt 03-05-2017
cards.details: Covers IMA, OTA and the cadet wings at CME, MCEME and MCTE. PBOR trainees get the difference between stipend plus DA and what they were paid in one sum.

cards.title: Pay of an officer taken prisoner of war
cards.answer: Full pay and allowances of the substantive rank, adjusted for any pay received from the enemy.
key: Applies once reported prisoner of war
cards.cite: Rule 55, Pay and Allowances Regulations for the Army

cards.title: What service counts towards increments, and does forfeiture matter?
cards.answer: Only full-pay commissioned service counts, including full-pay or furlough-rate leave. Forfeiture hits only future increments.
key: Forfeiture by court martial is not retrospective
Forfeiture for promotion does not affect increment service
Summary trial seniority loss leaves promotion dates unchanged
cards.cite: Rule 41, Pay and Allowances Regulations for the Army; CGDA letter 6995/AFL dt 17-07-1967
cards.details: Increments fall on 1 January or 1 July. Incentive for small family norms was abolished from 01-07-2017 under MoF DoE OM 12(4)/2016-EIII.A dt 07-07-2017.

cards.title: How are time-scale promotions earned, up to Colonel?
cards.answer: By time scale, regardless of vacancies, once you complete the service period, pass the exam and are fit. Colonel (TS) also by time scale.
key: General cadre: Captain 2 years, Major 6, Lt Col 13
Colonel (TS) at 26 years
Time-scale Colonel is held against a Lt Colonel post
cards.details: Effective 16-12-2004 after the AVS Committee. Special List officers use the same 2, 6 and 13 years.

cards.title: Time-scale promotion years for AMC, ADC and RVC officers
cards.answer: AMC: Major after 4 years as Captain, Lt Col after 11, Colonel (TS) after 24. ADC and RVC run about six months later.
key: ADC with internship: Major 4y6m, Lt Col 11y6m, Col 24y6m
ADC without internship: one more year each
RVC: Major 4y6m, Lt Col 11y6m, Col (TS) 24y6m
cards.details: AMC (NT) follows the general cadre years (2, 6, 13, 26) under MoD letter 10(3)(1)/05-D(Med) dt 28-10-2005.

cards.title: Time-scale promotion years for MNS, TA and Special List officers
cards.answer: MNS: Captain 3 years, Major 8, Lt Col 16. TA: Captain 4, Major 8, Lt Col 15, Colonel 28.
key: AMC (TA): Captain on commission, Major 7, Lt Col 14, Col 27
Special List: Captain 2, Major 6, Lt Col 13

cards.title: Substantive rank for SSC officers
cards.answer: Old-term SSC officers are placed on par with permanent officers: Captain at 2 years, Major 6, Lt Col 13.
key: Seniority reduced by the shorter training period
Pay re-fixed notionally; new pay from 14-03-2012
Retired or deceased before 20-07-2006: notional benefit only
cards.details: Following the Supreme Court order of 29-01-2018. Not applicable to SSC and women officers already given PC. SSC women are considered for PC from 25-02-2019 and opt after 3 years (MoD letter 14(01)/2020-D(AG) dt 16-07-2020).

cards.title: What is in-situ promotion and what does it pay?
cards.answer: A senior empanelled officer is promoted in place for at most six months, until posted to the earmarked appointment.
key: For Brigadier and above; extended to Colonel from 01-08-2009
Pay of the rank of the appointment held
The officiating incumbent gets no officiating allowance
cards.cite: MoD ID 19(28)/2009-D(MS) dt 20-05-2009; AHQ MS Branch letters 04477/MS 9B/P dt 07-10-1986 and 04502/MS Policy dt 14-05-2009

cards.title: Ages of retirement for combat arms and services
cards.answer: Armoured, Infantry, Artillery, Engineers, Signals, Intelligence: Major 52, Lt Col and Colonel 54, Brigadier 56, Major General 58, Lt General 60.
key: ASC, AOC, EME, Pioneers: Major and below 54
Others in that group as for combat arms
Food Inspection cadre: Lt Col and Colonel 57

cards.title: Ages of retirement for AMC, ADC, RVC and MNS officers
cards.answer: Up to Lt Col 56, Colonel 58, Brigadier 59, Major General 60. Lt General and DGAFMS serve a fixed tenure.
key: Lt General (not DGAFMS): 2 years or age 61, not before 60
DGAFMS: 3 years or age 62, not before 60
AMC (NT): up to Colonel 57, Brigadier 59
cards.details: AMC (NT): Colonel (Selection) 57, Brigadier (Records) 58, Major General 60, per MoD letters of 10-11-2006, 24-03-2009 and 26-12-2017.

cards.title: Ages of retirement for Special List, RC, NCC and TA officers
cards.answer: Special List and AEC, APTC, JAG: Colonel and below 57, Brigadier 58, Major General 59, Lt General 60. RC officers: 52 or 12 years.
key: NCC whole-time permanent officers: 57 years
AMC (TA), MNS (TA): Lt Col 56, Colonel 58, Brigadier 59
TA Colonel (TS): 56 or 4 years tenure, not before 54
cards.cite: MoD letter 18(1)/2004-D(GS-I) dt 21-12-2004; MoD letter 72512/AMC/TA-4/409/US/D(GS-III) dt 28-05-2008; MoD letter 46347/Amdt/R-14/TA-4/71/US/D(GS-III)/2017 dt 19-09-2017
cards.details: RC officers: AI 5/93 and 32/89. NCC officers retire at noon on the month-end following the 57th birthday; a 1st-of-month birthday retires them at the previous month-end.

cards.title: Is leave a right, and can holidays be tacked on?
cards.answer: Leave is never a right; it depends on exigencies of service. You may prefix or suffix recognised holidays with the CO's permission.
key: Holidays do not count against leave days
Saturdays count as holidays in five-day-week units
Restricted holidays also count
cards.cite: Rules 2 and 4 with Notes, Leave Rules for the Services Vol I (Army)
cards.details: The tacking-on concession does not apply where another special commencement or termination concession is sanctioned. No extra expense may fall on the State.

cards.title: How much casual leave do I get, and can it be combined?
cards.answer: Twenty days in a calendar year, up to 20 days at a time, and it cannot be combined with other leave.
key: Must be taken within the year it is due
Spill into next year is debited to each year separately
Exception: sporting events under Rule 72(A)
cards.cite: Rules 10 and 17, Leave Rules for the Services Vol I (Army); MoD letter B/33922/AG/PS-2(b)/2628/D(AG) dt 25-06-2007
cards.details: Abroad on deputation or course, casual leave is at the Head of Mission's discretion and must not extend the deputation (Rule 71(1)).

cards.title: When is special casual leave granted for sports, IIPA or scientific meetings?
cards.answer: Sports: up to 30 days a year, only as a representative of a recognised team. IIPA: 6 working days. Scientific bodies: as needed.
key: Sport: national or international events, not personal entry
IIPA: officers outside Delhi, plus journey time
Sanctioned by the CoAS or Director level for sport
cards.cite: Rules 72, 74, 75, Leave Rules for the Services Vol I (Army); MoD letter B/25571/AG/PS3(b)/3335/D(Pay/Services) dt 04-10-1991
cards.details: Sports leave may combine with casual leave or regular leave, not both at once. Trekking expeditions approved by the Indian Mountaineering Foundation also qualify. No TA/DA for IIPA moves. Scientific meeting leave is sanctioned by the casual leave authority, not below Brigadier or Sub Area Commander.

cards.title: Special casual leave after sterilisation operations
cards.answer: Seven days for a male officer whose wife is operated; up to 14 days for a female officer. Complications and recanalisation have their own limits.
key: IUCD insertion: one day for female officers
Wife's husband's vasectomy: one day
Recanalisation: 21 days or hospital stay, whichever is less
cards.cite: Rule 73, Leave Rules for the Services Vol I (Army); MoD letter B/33927/AG/PS-2(D)/432/D(AG) dt 19-02-1997
cards.details: Post-operative complications: whole period of hospitalisation, plus up to 7 days after tubectomy if still unfit though not hospitalised.

cards.title: Annual leave: how many days and when are they credited?
cards.answer: Sixty days a year, credited on 1 January with no duty condition. It may be taken in spells.
key: Leave running into next year debits the starting year
First-commission leave counts against the year you join duty
Accumulates up to 300 days for encashment, 30 a year
cards.cite: Rule 69, Leave Rules for the Services Vol I (Army); MoD Case B/33922/AG/PS-2(b)/642/D(AG) dt 04-04-2011
cards.details: Effective 04-04-2011. Retiring on 31 Jan: 30 days, in February 58 or 59 days, in March or later 60 days (AG's Br letters of 15-06-2012 and 27-07-2015). SSC officers cannot accumulate leave in the year of release. Accumulation for encashment in the retirement year: 15 days if retiring 31 Jan, 30 days otherwise.

cards.title: Annual leave on deputation, course abroad, UN mission or re-employment
cards.answer: UN deputees may carry forward 30 days a year. Re-employed officers get only the unavailed part of 60 days.
key: Abroad: leave sanctioned by the Head of Mission
Personal leave over 14 days or half the tour needs sanction
Re-employed after 30-day gap or in December: 30 days
cards.cite: MoD letter 17(21)/2006/D(GS-I) dt 24-08-2009; AG's Br letter B/33938/AG/PS-2(b) dt 17-05-2016
cards.details: Leave taken in continuation of an overseas course for personal reasons gets no transit time for return unless it is within 14 days or 50% of the duty period, or on medical grounds.

cards.title: Furlough leave: entitlement and rules
cards.answer: Two months (60 days) in every three calendar years from commission. It does not accumulate.
key: Not for NCC whole-time or re-employed officers
SSC officers with 3 years' service are entitled
Combined with annual leave: annual leave first, furlough last
cards.cite: Rules 19 and 47, Leave Rules for the Services Vol I (Army)
cards.details: Furlough can be taken in spells at any time after the three-year cycle begins. Furlough running into the next cycle is debited to the cycle it started in.

cards.title: Sick leave: how long and who extends it?
cards.answer: Sick leave applies when sickness exceeds 30 days. First grant up to six months including annual leave due, then extensions.
key: Extensions of 3 months each on medical board advice
Total 12 months, extendable to 24 by the sanctioning authority
Counts from the first day of admission to hospital
cards.cite: Rule 20, Leave Rules for the Services Vol I (Army); AO 148/77
cards.details: Furlough rates beyond six months need a Part II order notifying the extension. If invaliding is under way, the Adjutant General may extend by 3 months beyond the first six. If sick leave spills into the next year, the next year's annual leave is debited against the hospital stay.

cards.title: Leave on invalidment and tuberculosis treatment
cards.answer: Attributable sickness: up to 8 months' leave from the first day of absence. Pulmonary TB: up to 12 months with full pay.
key: Only for officers placed in medical category E and retained in hospital
TB patients can run beyond 8 months until medical finality
Not available for non-attributable cases
cards.cite: Rule 22, Leave Rules for the Services Vol I (Army); MoD letter 22679/DGAFMS/DG-3A/2721/D(Med) dt 18-07-1974
cards.details: For TB or non-lepromatous leprosy, treatment runs up to 12 months on full emoluments from the definite diagnosis, which must be made within 60 days. See Appendix A to AO 150/75.

cards.title: What is the sick list concession?
cards.answer: It is not leave. Sickness of up to 30 days on duty or on casual leave is treated as duty.
key: Cause of sickness must be beyond your control
Over 30 days: the whole period becomes sick leave
Sick on casual leave: sick leave starts when you fall sick
cards.cite: Rule 21, Leave Rules for the Services Vol I (Army)

cards.title: Terminal leave for short service officers
cards.answer: SSC officers with a first term of five years or more get 28 days' full-pay terminal leave on release.
key: Needs a Non-Employment Certificate; medical officers also non-practising
Without it: half pay without DA
Added to the annual leave due for the release year
cards.cite: Rule 51, Leave Rules for the Services Vol I (Army); AHQ MS Br letter 36963/MS7 dt 28-03-1972
cards.details: Strike off strength is the day after the leave ends. The year of release's annual leave cannot be accumulated for encashment.

cards.title: Maternity leave for women officers
cards.answer: 180 days on full pay for each confinement, limited to two surviving children.
key: Miscarriage or MTP: 30 days, max twice in service, 24 months apart
One further month without pay in exceptional cases
Applies to NCC lady officers and MNS
cards.cite: MoD letter B/33922/AG/PS-2(b)/943/D(AG) dt 16-03-2009; Rule 56, Leave Rules for the Services Vol I (Army)
cards.details: Effective 01-09-2008. Nursing officers taking maternity leave in the first year give an undertaking to serve a further year after rejoining.

cards.title: Child care leave: how much and for which children?
cards.answer: Permanent commission women get 360 days, SSC women 180 days, over the whole career for two eldest children under 18.
key: Disability of 40% or more: no age limit on the child
Single male officers and fathers now eligible too
Adoptee mothers also eligible
cards.cite: Rule 56A, Leave Rules for the Services Vol I (Army); MoD letters B/33922/AG/PS-2(b)/687/D(AG) dt 04-03-2014 and /1447/D(AG) dt 14-08-2019
cards.details: Single male means unmarried, widower or divorcee. A spell is 5 to 30 days, at most 2 spells and 60 days a year (minimum and the disability waiver from 14-08-2019). SSC officers later given PC receive the difference up to 360 days.

cards.title: Child care leave: spells, limits and combinations
cards.answer: At most two spells a year, 5 to 30 days each, up to 60 days a year. It is not debited to other leave.
key: Combine with any leave except casual leave
Not granted during probation or training
LTC allowed during CCL for women officers
cards.cite: Rule 56A, Leave Rules for the Services Vol I (Army); MoD letter B/33922/AG/PS-2(b)/3080/D(AG-II) dt 19-11-2018
cards.details: A spell running into the next year counts against the starting year. Holidays within the leave count. Foreign travel needs the same security clearance as ex-India leave. CCL is never a right.

cards.title: Leave on adopting a child
cards.answer: Women PC and SSC officers with fewer than two living children get 180 days on adopting a child under one year.
key: Granted in one spell straight after adoption
May combine with annual and furlough leave, scaled by child's age
Not debited to your leave account
cards.cite: Rule 56B, Leave Rules for the Services Vol I (Army); MoD letter B/33922/AG/PS-2(b)/5/US(AG-II)/D(AG) dt 15-01-2016
cards.details: Child under 9 months: up to four months of annual plus furlough; 9 to 12 months: up to three. Leave salary is the pay drawn just before leave. Effective 15-01-2016.

cards.title: Paternity leave on birth or adoption
cards.answer: Male officers with fewer than two living children get 15 days, on a birth or on adopting a child under one year.
key: Birth: from 15 days before delivery to 6 months after
Adoption: within 6 months of valid adoption
Combine with annual leave
cards.cite: Rules 14A and 14B, Leave Rules for the Services Vol I (Army); MoD letter B/33922/AG/PS-2(b)/5/US(AG-II)/D(AG) dt 15-01-2016

cards.title: Study leave for regular officers (not AMC, ADC, RVC)
cards.answer: Up to 24 months for approved non-academic courses, extendable to 28 with annual and furlough leave, at most twice in service.
key: Needs 5 years' service and 3 years left before retirement
Full pay and allowances drawn; no TA normally
Undertaking not to retire or resign for 3 years
cards.cite: Rules 27 and 28, Leave Rules for the Services Vol I (Army); AI 42/82; AO 11/87
cards.details: Leaving early or not finishing means refunding leave salary, fees and expenses with interest, unless relieved on health or compassion. Journey time counts as study leave but without allowances. Apply to GS/MT Dte at IHQ of MoD (Army).

cards.title: Study leave for AMC, ADC and RVC officers
cards.answer: Postgraduate courses only, 6 to 24 months over a career. It cannot be combined with other leave.
key: Full pay, all allowances, and NPA are paid
Undertaking: no retirement or resignation for 5 years
Basic degree courses are not approved
cards.cite: Rules 28A, 29 and 30, Leave Rules for the Services Vol I (Army); Rule 211(a), Pay and Allowances Regulations for the Army
cards.details: Resigning after 5 years but before 12 years of service may mean refunding study allowance. RVC courses are approved by DRVS or DMF.

cards.title: Recall from study leave
cards.answer: DCOAS (IS&T) may recall you for operations or disciplinary matters, without refund of pay.
key: Witness: up to 40 days in all
Accused: up to four months
Extension up to 4 months; unused balance goes to leave or EOL
cards.cite: Rule 27, Leave Rules for the Services Vol I (Army); AI 42/82; AI 16/92; AI 1/2003
cards.details: If found culpable the study leave may be terminated at your cost. Travel between leave station and duty counts as TD. Recalled officers get no annual leave for that year on that basis.

cards.title: Ex-India leave rules for deputation or delegations abroad
cards.answer: Regulated by Rule 71. For tours under 8 days you may take up to 4 days' ex-India leave.
key: Holidays may be tacked on if no extra cost arises
Short-tour rule effective 30-06-2017
cards.cite: Rule 71, Leave Rules for the Services Vol I (Army); MoD letter B/33926/AG/PS-2(b)/4894/D(AG) dt 08-11-2011; MoD letter 13(3)/2017-D(AG) dt 30-06-2017

cards.title: Irregular leave and overstayal: who can regularise?
cards.answer: Up to 30 days: Divisional Commander. Up to 60 days: Corps Commander. More needs Government sanction.
key: Adjusted against future annual leave or EOL
Overstay from floods or quakes: IHQ may regularise up to 30 days
Adjustment against annual or furlough leave
cards.cite: MoD letter 90716/Redel/AG/PS-2(b)/776/D(AG) dt 16-02-1982; Rule 6(d)(i), Leave Rules for the Services Vol I (Army)

cards.title: How much leave can I encash?
cards.answer: Up to 300 days over service, with at most 30 days accumulated a year, based on annual leave at credit.
key: Year of retirement: 15 days if retiring 31 Jan, else 30
SSC: release year's leave is not encashable
Cashiered or dismissed: no encashment
cards.cite: MoD letter B/33931/AG/PS-2(b)/1908/D(AG) dt 12-04-2010; MoD letter B/33931/AG/PS-2(b)/2890/D(AG) dt 18-07-2011; MoD letter 59910/GS/TA-3(a)/1541/US/D(GS-III)/10 dt 11-02-2011; CGDA letter AT/I/1312/X dt 03-02-1999
cards.details: Effective 01-01-2006. SSC officers can claim at the end of each tenure within the same 300-day limit. TA officers are covered by the same rules.

cards.title: Leave encashment on invalidment or death in service
cards.answer: Invalided: unused annual leave of that year up to 30 days. Death in January or February: about half the leave due.
key: Sick leave is first debited against that year's annual leave
Death 31 January: 15 days; 5 January: 2 days
No cut for pension equivalent of DCRG
cards.details: Fractions are rounded to the nearest day. February deaths are worked out the same way.

cards.title: Leave encashment for new officers, re-employed and on civil deputation
cards.answer: A joiner on 30 or 31 December gets no accumulation that year. Re-employment leave cannot be accumulated.
key: Commissioned before 1 Dec, joined early Dec: up to 15 days
Civil deputation: PCDA(O) pays from Defence Estimates
cards.cite: AG's Br AHQ letter B/32238/AG/PS-2(b) dt 03-04-1998; MoD letter B/33931/AG/PS-2(b)/1364/2015/D(AG) dt 06-11-2015

cards.title: How much joining time do I get on a permanent posting?
cards.answer: Six days preparatory time plus journey time: one day per 500 km by rail, 250 km by road, 350 km by sea.
key: Air: actual time, part day counts as one
Distance is actual, not the railway's assumed distance
Counted as duty; Sundays ignored but count toward 30-day limit
cards.details: Journey by river is 150 km a day and by other means 25 km. The competent authority may extend joining time up to 30 days. Casual leave may be granted in place of joining time but the two cannot be combined. Joining time is intended for winding up and re-establishing the household.

cards.title: Joining time for a course or temporary duty
cards.answer: Admissible for courses over 6 months only if you give up service accommodation. Otherwise only the journey time.
key: No 6 days preparation from a field area
Not on return to the same station
Newly commissioned: actual journey only on first posting
cards.cite: Paras 5, 10 and 19, AO 259/73; CGDA letter 1223/AT-P dt 06-07-1973
cards.details: If posted on permanent duty while on TD or a course, joining time counts from that station. Combined with annual leave and furlough: annual leave first, furlough next, then joining time.

cards.title: Joining time reckoning, sickness, civil posting and handing-over days
cards.answer: Handing or taking over: 7 days with a stores check (10 if dispersed), 4 days otherwise, Sundays and holidays included.
key: Not when joining time is joined with annual leave on transfer
Not for interchange of posts within one unit
Transfer to civil or foreign service: the borrowing body's rules
cards.details: Falling sick in joining time and recovering within sick-list concession lets you take the balance. With annual leave on transfer, joining time runs from the old station, or the leave station if that gives less.

cards.title: What are the types of attachment of an officer?
cards.answer: Disciplinary or suspension, staff attachment up to six months, training attachment up to three months, and after hospital pending posting.
key: Staff attachment: held supernumerary in parent unit
Training attachment: no extra pay
After hospital: attached to your own arm's unit or SSO
cards.cite: Para 93, Regulations for the Army 1987; Para 7(d), AO 97/56; AI 106/60
cards.details: A low medical category officer attached pending posting after the unit moves to an operational area draws pay and allowances of the rank and appointment held.

cards.title: Pay while under arrest or suspension
cards.answer: Withholding under Army Act sections 90 and 91 is permissive, and only from the date the order is signed.
key: No retrospective withholding
Struck off strength; held supernumerary to establishment
Withheld pay cannot clear debts during withholding
cards.cite: Army Act sections 90, 91 and 93; Para 5, AO 17/01; Para 349, Regulations for the Army 1987
cards.details: If all pay is withheld and mess bills cannot be met, they are claimed from PCDA(O) under Para 1289 of the Regulations and Rules 538-539 of the Pay and Allowances Regulations.

cards.title: Where are penal deductions explained?
cards.answer: Penal deductions under sections 90 and 91 of the Army Act are detailed in AO 7/03.
key: Read AO 7/03 before disputing a deduction

cards.title: How is maintenance allowance for wife and children paid?
cards.answer: On sanction of the GOC-in-C only, up to 50% of pay and allowances. PCDA(O) does not act on a court order alone.
key: Starts and stops only on GOC-in-C communication
Base: pay level, DA, Technical Allowance
MSP counts from 07-07-2020

cards.title: Qualification Allowance for aviators and aviation instructors
cards.answer: Only aviation instructors and aviators with a green card get it; monthly rates depend on the grade held.
key: Master Instructor Rs 1,125; Senior I Rs 900; II Rs 630
Master Green Card Rs 900; Green Card Rs 630
Base rates from 01-07-2017; rise 25% per 50% DA
cards.cite: CGDA letter PC-II/1098/AT-P dt 28-12-1977; MoD letter 1(16)/2017/D(Pay/Services) dt 18-09-2017 and 14-09-2018
cards.details: A Part II order with the prescribed certificates is published every year.

cards.title: What happened to Qualification Grant after the 7th CPC?
cards.answer: It was abolished as a separate allowance from 01-07-2017. A Higher Qualification Incentive was proposed.
key: MoD orders on the incentive were still awaited in 2023
Do not claim Qualification Grant for new courses
CGDA stopped Qualification Grant payments in September 2022

cards.title: Test Pilot and Flight Test Engineer Allowance
cards.answer: Test pilots get Rs 5,300 a month, flight test engineers Rs 4,100, both from 01-07-2017 and rising 25% per 50% DA.
key: Test pilot: completed test pilot course, posted to AAPT Bengaluru
Also paid on leave or TD up to 3 months
Test pilot and Flying Allowance are paid together
cards.cite: MoD letter 1(16)/2017/D(Pay/Services) dt 18-09-2017 and 14-09-2018; MoD letter PC-26243/AG/PS3(a)/364/D(Pay/Services) dt 23-02-1995; MoD letter 00696/ALH/AA-5/1899/98/D(GS-I) dt 23-11-1998
cards.details: Test pilots are paid from 17-04-1993 while carrying out test pilot duties. Flight test engineers qualify on FTE or FTIE courses at ASTE Bengaluru or equivalent. Claims go with a Part II order citing the IHQ letter.

cards.title: When does Parachute Allowance start and stop?
cards.answer: It starts one month after the probationary attachment, if the course follows within three months, and ends when you leave the post.
key: No probation served: from the day you start the course
Failed through no fault: paid for training period at commander's discretion
Training injury: up to 91 days
cards.cite: Rules 100 and 101, Pay and Allowances Regulations for the Army
cards.details: If the gap between probation and the course exceeds three months, the allowance is paid retrospectively for no more than three months before the course. The Para Jump Instructor Allowance is Rs 10,500 a month from 01-07-2017 for those in authorised instructor appointments (MoD letter 1(16)/2017/D(Pay/Services) dt 18-09-2017).

cards.title: Special Force Allowance
cards.answer: Rs 25,000 a month from 01-07-2017 for officers of the Para (SF) commando units. It replaces Parachute and Para Reserve Allowance.
key: Rises 25% each time DA rises by 50%
Parachute continuance conditions apply
On return to parent unit Para pay resumes
cards.cite: MoD letter B/36389/AG/PS3(b)/82/S/D(Pay/Services) dt 29-01-1980 as amended; MoD letter 1(16)/2017/D(Pay/Services) dt 18-09-2017
cards.details: Applies to ten Para (SF) units: numbers one to four, nine to thirteen, and twenty-one.

cards.title: Is there an official hospitality grant now?
cards.answer: No. It was abolished from 30-06-2017; hospitality is office expenditure outside PCDA(O).
key: Nothing to claim from PCDA(O)
cards.cite: MoD letter 1(16)/2017/D(Pay/Services) dt 18-09-2017; MoF OM 11-1/2016/E.II B (7th CPC)/Pt.III(C) dt 10-04-2018

cards.title: NSG allowance for officers on deputation
cards.answer: Army officers deputed to NSG get 40% of basic pay in the pay matrix from 01-07-2017.
key: Based only on matrix basic pay, nothing else

cards.title: Dearness Allowance: when is it revised and what counts as pay?
cards.answer: DA is revised twice a year, from 1 January and 1 July, on matrix pay plus MSP and NPA only.
key: No other special pay is included
Paid on leave except leave without pay and allowances
Leave DA is based on leave salary actually drawn
cards.cite: Army Officers Pay Rules 2017, SRO 12(E) dt 03-05-2017

cards.title: What happened to Kit Maintenance Allowance?
cards.answer: It was merged into a single Dress Allowance from 01-07-2017.
key: Do not claim Kit Maintenance Allowance separately

cards.title: Special Compensatory (Counter Insurgency) Allowance: who and how much?
cards.answer: Troops on counter insurgency operations: Rs 16,900 in field areas, Rs 13,013 in modified field areas, Rs 10,500 in peace areas.
key: Base rates from 01-07-2017; rise 25% per 50% DA
Local unit needs commander's certificate of actual CI duty
Under 30 days: paid pro rata
cards.cite: MoD letter 1(16)/2017/D(Pay/Services) dt 18-09-2017 and 14-09-2018; MoD letter 37269/AG/PS3(a)/90/D(Pay/Services) dt 13-01-1994
cards.details: Operations named in the handbook: Rakshak, Rhino, Orchid and Hifazat I. No other area-based allowance is paid, but High Altitude Allowance is. Army officers in BRO units in J&K and the North East are not involved in CI operations and do not get it (MoD DO letter 16(1)/2006/D(Pay/Services) dt 02-07-2008).

cards.title: High Altitude Allowance: who qualifies and how much?
cards.answer: Posted to units at 9,000 feet or more. Monthly: Category I Rs 3,400, Category II Rs 5,300, Category III Rs 25,000.
key: Cat I: 9,000 to 15,000 feet; Cat II: above 15,000 feet
Cat III: 14,000 to 19,000 feet in notified difficult areas
Base rates from 01-07-2017; rise 25% per 50% DA
cards.cite: MoD letter F 69/3/75/D(Pay/Services) dt 28-02-1976; Rule 173, Pay and Allowances Regulations for the Army; MoD letter 1(16)/2017/D(Pay/Services) dt 18-09-2017
cards.details: Paid on permanent posting, on detachment or attachment over 14 days without DA, and in transit between qualifying areas. Not paid on annual or sick leave, or on duty elsewhere for over 14 days. Absence up to 14 days on sick list, casual leave or TD keeps it. Also paid with SCCIA and field area allowances, not with Siachen Allowance. MNS officers get the same.

cards.title: Training allowance for faculty: 24% or 12% of basic pay
cards.answer: Faculty at the listed training academies get 24% of basic pay, other listed establishments 12%, from 01-07-2017.
key: Only for faculty on posting who will go back
No Deputation Duty Allowance alongside
Not for permanent or administrative staff
cards.cite: MoD letter PC-1(16)/2017/D(Pay/Services)/Pt.II dt 28-11-2019; DoPT letter 13024/01/2016-Trg. Ref dt 24-10-2017
cards.details: 24%: NDC, DSSC, NDA, CDM, IMA, OTA Chennai, Army War College, CAATS, DIQA and ITM. 12%: AFMC, corps centres and schools, and all regimental training centres, as per Appendix B of the 2019 letter. Allowance continues during study or training tours and counts for leave salary.

cards.title: Deputation (Duty) Allowance: who gets it and how much?
cards.answer: For temporary transfer outside the regular line. Choose 50% of civil rates with service concessions or 100% without them.
key: Same station with concessions: 2.5%, max Rs 2,250
Change of station with concessions: 5%, max Rs 4,500
Without concessions: 5% or 10%, max Rs 4,500 or 9,000
cards.cite: MoD letter 13(1)/87/D(Pay/Services) dt 25-09-1987; MoD letter 1(16)/2017/D(Pay/Services) dt 18-09-2017 and 14-09-2018
cards.details: Percent is of basic pay; ceilings rise 25% per 50% DA, from 01-07-2017. Special pays like parachute or flying are not allowed with it unless the sanction says so; Technical, Specialist, NPA and Qualification Pay continue. Also payable to officers in civil employ, Estt 22 (SFF), Coast Guard and Assam Rifles. Not with Training Allowance or Special Security Allowance.

cards.title: Language Allowance and Language Award
cards.answer: Language Allowance: Category I Rs 2,025, II Rs 1,689, III Rs 1,350 a month. Language Award has no orders after 31-03-1997.
key: For translators, interpreters and instructors in active use
Must pass the annual School of Language test
Rates rise 25% each time DA rises by 50%
cards.cite: MoD letter 1(16)/2017/D(Pay/Services) dt 18-09-2017 and 14-09-2018; MoD letter 22(1)/83/D(GS-II) dt 03-02-1984
cards.details: Part II order certificate is endorsed by an officer of Lt Col rank or above. Base rates from 01-07-2017.

cards.title: Special Security Allowance for DG (Security), SFF and NTRO deputation
cards.answer: 20% of matrix basic pay from 01-07-2017, excluding MSP and special pay.
key: Replaces NTRO Special Allowance
Not with Deputation Duty Allowance
SFF officers also get Hazard Pay; Hard Area Allowance not alongside
cards.cite: Cabinet Secretariat Order 1/27/2016-EA.I-1332 dt 11-07-2017; NTRO order V(B)MISC(7th CPC)/19177/2014/20149-721 dt 02-08-2018; MoD letter 4(15)/58/99/S(MS) dt 25-02-1970
cards.details: Special Security Allowance began 05-06-2006 for SFF deputation under HQ 22 Establishment and 22-08-2005 for NTRO.

cards.title: Hazard Pay for Special Group (SFF)
cards.answer: Monthly by rank from 01-01-2014: Lieutenant Rs 13,500, Captain Rs 16,500, Major and above Rs 21,000.
key: 7th CPC revised rates were still awaited
cards.cite: Cabinet Secretariat Order 14(9)/89-EA.II-503 dt 03-06-2002; letter F.No.14(3)/2009-EA.II-376 dt 20-07-2010

cards.title: Hard Area Allowance in Nicobar, Minicoy and Lakshadweep
cards.answer: Nicobar and Minicoy: 20% of basic pay. Listed Lakshadweep islands: 12%. Choose the better of this or another special compensatory allowance.
key: Payable with Island Special Duty Allowance
Paid during leave and courses under MoF OM of 1965
With field concessions you get the higher of the two
cards.cite: MoD OM PC-1(16)/2017/D(Pay/Services) Pt.II dt 17-05-2018; MoF OM 2(37)-EII(B)/64 dt 27-11-1965
cards.details: Applies from 01-07-2017. Not paid with Special Security Allowance.

cards.title: Hardship Allowance for SFF at Chakrata
cards.answer: 10% of basic pay from 01-07-2017 for officers on SFF deputation at Chakrata.
key: In place of Special Duty Allowance
Not with CFAA, CMFAA or SCCIA
Not during any leave, joining time or suspension
cards.cite: Cabinet Secretariat Order 20/5/2017-EA-I-1808 dt 20-09-2018; Cabinet Secretariat Order 23/14/2006-EA.III dt 16-03-2009

cards.title: SPIC Allowance
cards.answer: Rs 16,900 a month at SPIC sites, Rs 10,500 at SPIC HQ, from 01-07-2017.
key: Director SPIC certifies admissibility
Payable with Flying, Field or Deputation Allowance
Rises 25% each time DA rises by 50%
cards.cite: MoD DRDO letter SPIC/SPL ALLCE/ADMIN/2017/459/S/R&D dt 28-12-2017

cards.title: Child care allowance for women officers with disability
cards.answer: Women with at least 40% disability get Rs 3,000 a month from the child's birth until two years of age.
key: Maximum two eldest surviving children
No double rate for multiple births
Rises 25% each time DA rises by 50%
cards.cite: MoD letter 1(23)/2017/D(Pay/Services) dt 15-09-2017; DoPT OM 12011/04/2008-Estt.(Allowance) dt 11-09-2008

cards.title: Strategic Forces Allowance
cards.answer: Rs 16,900 a month for officers of Installation Security Force; Rs 10,500 for HQ SFC and its units, from 01-07-2017.
key: Rises 25% each time DA rises by 50%

cards.title: Dress Allowance: how much and when is it paid?
cards.answer: Rs 20,000 a year for Army officers, Rs 15,000 for MNS, credited once a year in July from 01-07-2017.
key: Covers only the basic uniform, not special clothing
From 01-01-2024, after the 25% step: Rs 25,000 (MNS Rs 18,750)
Replaces outfit and kit maintenance allowances
cards.details: Recovery if you leave in the year: superannuation July-Sept 60%, Oct-Dec 40%, Jan-Mar 25%, Apr-Jun nil. Voluntary retirement or resignation: 80%, 55%, 33%, nil. No recovery on death or invaliding beyond your control (MoD letter 1(4)2019/D(Pay/Services) dt 01-03-2021).

cards.title: Is there any compensation for a change of uniform?
cards.answer: No. Dress Allowance replaced all uniform allowances, and the order has no reimbursement for a change of regiment or corps.
key: Do not claim clothing, shoe, robe or washing allowance
NSG and Assam Rifles officers lose 28 basic uniform items

cards.title: Compensatory allowances and Hill Compensatory Allowance
cards.answer: Army officers get compensatory allowances at the civilian rates and rules for the same locality. Composite Hill allowance ended 01-07-2017.
key: MNS officers included
Hill Compensatory Allowance is abolished

cards.title: Tough Location Allowance: rates and what it replaced
cards.answer: It replaced SC(RL)A from 01-07-2017: TLA-I Rs 5,300, TLA-II Rs 3,400, TLA-III Rs 1,200 a month.
key: Part A or B places: TLA-I; Part C: TLA-II; Part D: TLA-III
A place in two parts gets the higher rate
With field concessions, take the higher of the two
cards.cite: MoD letter 1(16)/2017/D(Pay/Services) dt 16-11-2017; DoE OM 3/1/2017-E.II(B) dt 19-07-2017
cards.details: Whole states: Assam, Meghalaya Part D; Manipur Part C; Nagaland Part B; Sikkim and Lakshadweep Part A. Others are listed by district in the annexure. Rates rise 25% each time DA rises by 50%.

cards.title: Tough Location Allowance on leave, TD, arrest or suspension
cards.answer: Continues on leave for 180 days at a time, 8 months for TB, cancer or long illness. Needs family residence certificate after 180 days.
key: Temporary duty up to six months at the same rate
Arrest or suspension: paid later if acquitted or cleared
Husband and wife both get it if otherwise eligible
cards.cite: Rules 265 to 277, Pay and Allowances Regulations for the Army; MoD letter 1(37)/87/4405/D(Pay/Services) dt 28-07-1987
cards.details: Eligibility follows the place of duty and normally needs permanent posting. TD officers get it if they draw no daily allowance. The family certificate says you or your family stayed at the same station (or nearby area). Family excludes members with independent income above a pension of Rs 9,000.

cards.title: Island Special Duty Allowance
cards.answer: Percent of matrix basic pay in the islands: 10% near capital towns, 16% in difficult areas, 20% in more difficult areas.
key: Leave or training: 15 days at a time, 30 a year
Not during suspension or joining time
Paid along with TLA; with field concessions take the higher
cards.cite: MoD letter 1(26)/97/V/D(Pay/Services) dt 29-02-2000; MoD letter 1(16)/2017/D(Pay/Services) dt 18-09-2017; MoF OM 20022/68E.II(B) dt 24-05-1989
cards.details: 10%: Port Blair, Kavaratti, Agatti. 16%: North, Middle and South Andaman (not Port Blair), Lakshadweep except Kavaratti, Agatti, Minicoy. 20%: Little Andaman, Nicobar, Narcondam, East Island, Minicoy. Applies from 01-07-2017.

cards.title: Crockery and cutlery grants for officers posted abroad
cards.answer: Representational crockery: Rs 8,600 or Rs 13,000 by rank, on each posting. CCG: Rs 3,400 lump sum for daily crockery.
key: Not for UN mission or IMTRAT Bhutan
Crockery grant: at most six times in foreign postings
CCG halves next time if tenure was under 18 months
cards.cite: MoD letter B/25987/AG/PS3(a) dt 29-10-1987; MoD letter 4(1)/2011/D(Pay/Services) dt 19-08-2011; CGDA letter AT/IV/4887/VII dt 17-03-1998
cards.details: Representational grant: Rs 8,600 for Colonel, Lt Col, Major, Captain and Lieutenant equivalents (12-person set), Rs 13,000 for Brigadier and Major General equivalents (18-person set). Head of Mission countersigns a certificate. From 31-12-2008.

cards.title: Lump sum for bed and table linen for military attachés
cards.answer: Military attachés posted abroad receive a prescribed lump sum in place of linen, released by the regional PCDA or CDA.
key: Attachés are borne at DGMI Foreign Division (OA)
cards.cite: MoD letter 4(1)/2011/D(Pay/Services) dt 19-08-2011; CGDA letter AT/I/0/42/VLL dt 26-02-1991

cards.title: Bhutan Compensatory Allowance at IMTRAT and Dantak
cards.answer: Paid instead of Indian DA at rates notified by MEA, plus servant wages, on Appendix A to AO 31/80.
key: Stops each September and March until the six-monthly certificate arrives
Leave up to 14 days: no recovery
Longer leave: 25% recovery for the whole leave
cards.details: Income tax on salary is reimbursed as Additional Foreign Allowance each February, pro rata for part years. Two full-time servants are paid Rs 5,456 each a month. Difficult Area Allowance is paid in specified IMTRAT areas. The 6% depression on BCA was dropped from 11-02-2019. No crockery grant. Transport allowance is for India only.

cards.title: Myanmar Compensatory Allowance
cards.answer: Officers with units under HQ 760 BRTF Myanmar get the same rates, servant wages and leave conditions as IMTRAT Bhutan.
key: Claim as for Bhutan Compensatory Allowance

cards.title: Claims you must not send to PCDA(O)
cards.answer: Briefcase allowance, bed and linen charges, telephone bills and indoor medical claims go to the Regional Controller.
key: Submit to the Controller of the unit's region

cards.title: Which advances remain after the 7th CPC?
cards.answer: Interest-free advances for medical treatment, travelling on tour or transfer, LTC, and TA for a deceased's family stay. Pay advances are abolished.
key: Advance of pay on transfer and leave salary: abolished
Interest-bearing car and two-wheeler advances: discontinued
cards.cite: MoF DoE OM 12(1)/E.II(A)/2016 dt 07-10-2016, amending Rule 21(5) of the Compendium of Rules on Advances

cards.title: House building advance and conveyance advance now
cards.answer: Conveyance and computer advances were discontinued. HBA for Army officers follows the 2017 rules as extended by MoD in June 2023.
key: New house: 34 months' basic pay, up to Rs 7 lakh
Expansion: up to Rs 6 lakh; cost cap 139x basic pay
Interest 8.5% from 2017-18; reviewed every three years
cards.cite: MoD (DMA) letter F.No.15(1)/2017/D(Pay/Services) dt 19-06-2023; MoHUA OM dt 09-11-2017; MoF DoE OM 12(1)/E.II(A)/2016 dt 07-10-2016
cards.details: Cost cap is at most Rs 60 lakh, relaxable by up to 25% by the head of department. Principal is repaid in up to 180 instalments, then interest in up to 60. The advance is the least of the pay-based limit, cost, or repaying capacity.

cards.title: DSOP Fund: who subscribes and how much?
cards.answer: Compulsory after one year's service, at least 6% of emoluments (matrix basic pay plus NPA, excluding DA).
key: Optional for re-employed officers
Raise twice and reduce once in a financial year
Recovery stops for the last three months before retirement
cards.details: If the account goes into debit the subscription drops to the minimum, restored after clearing. Subscription above 6% cannot exceed what remains after statutory recoveries such as tax and AGIF. Interest has been 7.1% a year since 01-04-2020 (earlier years 7.6% to 8%); the rate is reset each quarter, so show it with its quarter.

cards.title: DSOP Fund advance: purposes, limit and time
cards.answer: The lower of one year's pay and 75% of your balance, repaid within 60 instalments.
key: Illness, education, marriage, funerals, legal, durables, pilgrimage
Sanction within 15 days; 7 in emergencies
A simple declaration is enough; no proof
cards.cite: MoD letter B/36293/AG/PS3(c)/2063/D(Pay/Services) dt 09-10-1996; MoD letter C/7026/VII CPC/73/423/D(Pay/Services) dt 22-05-2019; DoP&PW OM 3/2/2017-P&PW(F)(i) dt 07-03-2017
cards.details: Effective 07-03-2017. A new advance absorbs any balance of the old. Recovery starts from the pay for the month after drawal. An advance can later be converted into a final withdrawal if conditions are met. Sanctioning authority follows AI 22/96 as amended by AI 09/98.

cards.title: DSOP Fund withdrawal: purposes and limits
cards.answer: After 10 years: 12 months of pay or three-quarters of the balance for education, marriage, illness or durables. Illness up to 90%.
key: Housing: up to 90%, at any time in service
Vehicle: three-quarters of balance or cost, after 10 years
Final withdrawal up to 90% in the last two years
cards.cite: MoD letter B/36293/AG/PS3(c)/2063/D(Pay/Services) dt 09-10-1996; MoD letter C/7026/VII CPC/73/423/D(Pay/Services) dt 22-05-2019; DoP&PW OM 3/2/2017-P&PW(F)(ii) dt 07-03-2017
cards.details: Housing covers building, buying, repaying a house loan and renovating an ancestral house, with proof of share. No repayment on sale of the house. Housing withdrawal is no longer tied to HBA limits. One withdrawal per purpose. VCOAS or GOC-in-C sanctions up to 90%; others up to 75%.

cards.title: DSOP Fund nomination and who counts as family
cards.answer: You may nominate family members only, split by share, and cancel by notice. Family differs for male and female subscribers.
key: Male: wife, parents, children, minor brothers, unmarried sisters
Female: husband may be excluded by written notice
Nomination sent to head of office stays valid
cards.details: Also family: deceased son's widow and children, and a paternal grandparent if no parent lives. A judicially separated wife stops being family unless you say in writing she continues. Child includes an adopted child and a ward living with you under a special will.

cards.title: When is the DSOP Fund balance paid out?
cards.answer: Payable on quitting, dismissal, release, retirement, being declared unfit, or death (to nominee or family).
key: Interest runs up to six months after you leave service
No nomination: paid to family members
Update bank, unit address and rate on AO 24/05 forms
cards.details: Government dues are not recovered from the final payment unless you consent. Up to Rs 10,000 can go to a guardian of minors without a guardianship certificate. A missing officer's family needs a police report and an indemnity bond. Rate change forms go to PCDA(O) a month ahead.

food_rate.assumption: full day (over 12 hours away), before taxes

ctg.assumption: move of 20 km or more, not to or from Andaman, Nicobar or Lakshadweep (100% there)
